第一品Chapter One

比库巴帝摩卡序论Introduction to the Bhikkhupātimokkha

第一节 什么是比库巴帝摩卡Section 1: What Is the Bhikkhupātimokkha?

什么是比库巴帝摩卡呢？“比库巴帝摩卡”是巴利语的音译，由“比库”和“巴帝摩卡”两个词组成。
What is the Bhikkhu Pātimokkha? “Bhikkhu Pātimokkha” is a transliteration of the Pāli expression, which consists of the two words bhikkhu and pātimokkha.
比库，巴利语bhikkhu的音译，有行乞者、穿破衣者、见怖畏等义。即于跋葛瓦的正法、律中出家并达上的男子。4
“Bhikkhu” is a transliteration of the Pāli word bhikkhu. The word carries such meanings as an alms-seeker, one who wears patched or torn robes, and one who sees danger. It denotes a man who has gone forth in the Blessed One’s Dhamma and Vinaya and has received the higher ordination.
《律藏zàng·巴拉基格》解释说：
The Pārājika section of the Vinaya Piṭaka explains:
“Bhikkhū'ti bhikkhako'ti bhikkhu, bhikkhācariyaṃ ajjhupagato'ti bhikkhu, bhinnapaṭadharo'ti bhikkhu.”
“比库，即乞讨者为比库，从事集食行为者为比库，穿破衣者为比库。”(V.1.45)
“A bhikkhu is one who seeks alms, one who practises collecting alms, and one who wears patched or torn cloth.” (V.1.45)
按照这种解释，“bhikkhu”一词主要是由巴利语bhikkhaka（乞讨者）或bhikkhā（集食）引申而来。
According to this explanation, the word bhikkhu is principally derived from the Pāli bhikkhaka, “one who seeks alms,” or bhikkhā, “the collecting of alms.”
根据律藏zàng义註，这里的“乞讨者”(bhikkhako)并非像开口向人乞讨东西的穷人或乞丐，而是不管获得或没获得，皆以高贵的方式求取者。
According to the Vinaya Commentary, “one who seeks alms” (bhikkhako) does not mean a poor person or beggar who verbally asks others for things. It means one who seeks what is needed in a noble manner, whether or not anything is obtained.
“从事集食行为者”(bhikkhācariyaṃ ajjhupagato)是指捨弃了少量或大量的财富，放弃了农耕、商业等工作，出离俗家而为无家者，过着如佛陀等一般以从事收集食物的方式资养色身、维持生活的人。
“One who has undertaken the practice of collecting alms” (bhikkhācariyaṃ ajjhupagato) means one who has relinquished little or much wealth, abandoned occupations such as agriculture and commerce, gone forth from the household life into homelessness, and sustains the body and life by collecting alms, as the Buddhas and other renunciants have done.
穿着把价值、触感和颜色三种皆破坏之衣者为比库。用刀剪等把高价的布料进行割截、裁剪为破坏价值(agghabhedo)；用针线缝纫而使原先有乐触的布料变成粗触为破坏触感(phassabhedo)；被针锈、汗水、染料等破坏了布料的原来色泽为破坏颜色(vaṇṇabhedo)。又或者以只穿着与在家衣服有别的袈裟者为穿破衣者(bhinnapaṭadharo)。(V.A.1.45)
One who wears cloth whose value, texture, and colour have all been altered is called a bhikkhu. Cutting costly cloth with a knife or scissors alters its value (agghabhedo); sewing it with needle and thread changes its formerly pleasant texture into a coarse one (phassabhedo); and rust from the needle, perspiration, and dye alter its original colour (vaṇṇabhedo). Alternatively, one who wears robes distinct from household clothing is described as one who wears patched or torn cloth (bhinnapaṭadharo). (V.A.1.45)
而在《清净之道》中则说：
The Visuddhimagga states:
“Bhikkhū'ti saṃsāre bhayaṃ ikkhaṇatāya vā bhinna- paṭadharāditāya vā evaṃ laddhavohāro saddhāpabbajito kulaputto.”
“比库者，以看见轮回的怖畏，或以穿破衣等，获得这样名称的信心出家的良家之子。”(Vm.14)
“A bhikkhu is a son of good family who has gone forth out of faith and is so called because he sees danger in saṃsāra, or because he wears patched and torn cloth, and so forth.” (Vm.14)
在此，“bhikkhu”一词是由巴利语bhaya（怖畏）+ ikkha（看见）组成，故以“见怖畏”之义为比库。
Here, bhikkhu is explained as being formed from the Pāli bhaya, “danger,” and ikkha, “to see”; hence a bhikkhu is “one who sees danger.”
因此，巴利语法书《词语导论·词根鬘》(Sadda- nītippakaraṇa Dhātumālā)把“bhikkhu”分为前缀bhi（怖畏，破）加上词根ikkha（看见）进行解释：
Accordingly, the Pāli grammatical treatise Saddanītippakaraṇa, in its Dhātumālā, explains bhikkhu through the prefix bhi, conveying danger or breaking, and the root ikkha, “to see”:
“Tathā hi kilese bhindatīti bhikkhu. Chinnabhinnapaṭa- dharotipi bhikkhu. Bhikkhanasīlotipi bhikkhu. Saṃsāre bhayaṃ ikkhati, ikkhanasīloti vā bhikkhu.”
“如此，破烦恼为比库，穿割截的破衣者为比库，乞求戒者为比库，看见轮回的怖畏，或看护戒者为比库。”(p.369)
“One who breaks the defilements is a bhikkhu; one who wears cut and torn cloth is a bhikkhu; one whose practice is to seek alms is a bhikkhu; and one who sees danger in saṃsāra, or whose practice is to see, is a bhikkhu.” (p.369)
巴帝摩卡，巴利语pātimokkha的音译，有最初、上首、极殊胜、极尊贵、护解脱等义。
“Pātimokkha” is a transliteration of the Pāli word pātimokkha. It conveys such meanings as the beginning, the head, the foremost, the most excellent, the most noble, and liberation through protection.
《律藏zàng·大品·诵戒篇》中解释：
The Uposatha chapter of the Mahāvagga in the Vinaya Piṭaka explains:
“Pātimokkhan'ti ādimetaṃ mukhametaṃ pamukham- etaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ, Tena vuccati pātimokkhan'ti.”
“巴帝摩卡者，此是最初，此是头首，此是诸善法之上首，因此称为‘巴帝摩卡’。”(V.3.135)
“The Pātimokkha is the beginning, the head, and the foremost of wholesome qualities; therefore it is called ‘Pātimokkha.’” (V.3.135)
律义註《疑惑度脱》(Kaṅkhāvitaraṇī)解释说：
The Vinaya commentary Kaṅkhāvitaraṇī explains:
“Pātimokkhan'ti pa-atimokkhaṃ atipamokkhaṃ atiseṭṭhaṃ ati-uttamanti attho.”
“巴帝摩卡为极殊胜、极上首、极尊、极上之义。”(Kv.p.84)
“Pātimokkha means exceedingly eminent, exceedingly foremost, exceedingly excellent, and exceedingly supreme.” (Kv.p.84)
按照这种解释，“pātimokkha”一词是由巴利语pa-ati（极）+ mokkha（殊胜），或由ati（极）+ pāmokkha（上首）组成，故以“极殊胜，极上首”等义为巴帝摩卡。
According to this explanation, pātimokkha is analysed as pa-ati, “exceedingly,” plus mokkha, “eminent,” or ati, “exceedingly,” plus pāmokkha, “foremost.” Thus it carries such meanings as “exceedingly eminent” and “exceedingly foremost.”
该义註接着又说：
The commentary continues:
“Tattha sīlaṃ yo naṃ pāti rakkhati, taṃ mokkheti mocayati āpāyikādīhi dukkhehi, attānuvādādīhi vā bhayehī'ti pātimokkhaṃ.”
“其中的戒是若看护、保护此者，能解脱、脱离恶趣等苦，或者自责等怖畏，故为巴帝摩卡。”(Kv.p.84; 参考Vm.14)
“The virtue that one guards and protects frees one from suffering such as the states of loss, or from dangers such as self-reproach; therefore it is called Pātimokkha.” (Kv.p.84; cf. Vm.14)
在此，“pātimokkha”一词是由巴利语pāti（看护）+ mokkha（解脱）组成，故以“护解脱”之义为巴帝摩卡。
Here, pātimokkha is explained through the Pāli pāti, “guards or protects,” and mokkha, “liberation”; hence it has the sense of “liberation through protection.”
因为“巴帝摩卡”含有多义，所以通常采用音译，必要时才意译为“护解脱”。5
Because pātimokkha has several meanings, it is normally transliterated; when a translation is required, it may be rendered as “liberation through protection.”

第二节 巴帝摩卡的分类Section 2: Classification of the Pātimokkha

“巴帝摩卡”依表现形式可以分为戒巴帝摩卡和经籍巴帝摩卡两种：
According to its mode of expression, the Pātimokkha is divided into two kinds: the Pātimokkha as virtue and the Pātimokkha as text.
1. 戒巴帝摩卡(sīla pātimokkha)——即通过看护而解脱恶趣等苦与自责等怖畏的戒。
1. The Pātimokkha as virtue (sīla pātimokkha)—the virtue whose careful observance frees one from such suffering as rebirth in a bad destination and from such fears as self-reproach.
2. 经籍巴帝摩卡(gantha pātimokkha)——即僧团每半月半月念诵的戒经，分为《比库巴帝摩卡》和《比库尼巴帝摩卡》两部戒经。(Kv.p.84)
2. The Pātimokkha as text (gantha pātimokkha)—the disciplinary text recited by the Saṅgha every half-month. It comprises two texts: the Bhikkhu Pātimokkha and the Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha. (Kv.p.84)
“巴帝摩卡”又依所受持之众可以分为比库巴帝摩卡和比库尼巴帝摩卡两种：
The Pātimokkha may also be classified according to those who observe it into the Bhikkhu Pātimokkha and the Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha:
1. 比库巴帝摩卡(bhikkhupātimokkha)——比库应持守的巴帝摩卡防护戒，共有227学处。
1. Bhikkhu Pātimokkha (bhikkhupātimokkha)—the Pātimokkha restraint to be observed by bhikkhus, comprising 227 training rules.
2. 比库尼巴帝摩卡(bhikkhunīpātimokkha)——比库尼应持守的巴帝摩卡防护戒，共有311学处。
2. Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha (bhikkhunīpātimokkha)—the Pātimokkha restraint to be observed by bhikkhunīs, comprising 311 training rules.
“巴帝摩卡”还可以依诵者而分为教诲巴帝摩卡和威令巴帝摩卡两种：
"Pātimokkha" can also be divided into two categories of preachers: Pātimokkha and Pātimokkha:
1. 教诲巴帝摩卡(ovādapātimokkha)——只是由“忍耐是最高苦行”等三首偈颂组成，而且只是由诸佛诵出，并非由弟子在各自的寺院诵出。这是佛陀尚未为弟子制定学处时，整个瞻部洲(Jambudīpa, 印度)的所有比库僧团于某一时齐集佛陀之处，由佛陀向他们诵出的巴帝摩卡。
1. The Exhortation Pātimokkha (ovādapātimokkha)—consisting solely of the three verses beginning ‘Patience is the highest ascetic practice’—was recited only by Buddhas, not by disciples in their respective monasteries. Before the Buddha had laid down training rules for his disciples, all the communities of bhikkhus throughout Jambudīpa (India) would assemble together in the Buddha’s presence, and the Buddha would recite this Pātimokkha to them.
2.威令巴帝摩卡(āṇāpātimokkha)——自从佛陀为弟子制定学处以後，即由弟子僧团每半月半月齐集于各自居住的寺院所念诵的巴帝摩卡。(V.A.1.19)
2. The Authoritative Pātimokkha (āṇāpātimokkha)—after the Buddha had laid down training rules for his disciples, their communities assembled every fortnight in their respective monasteries and recited this Pātimokkha. (V.A.1.19)
以上三种分类中，戒即是巴帝摩卡，而经籍巴帝摩卡包括《比库巴帝摩卡》和《比库尼巴帝摩卡》两部戒经，它们皆属于威令巴帝摩卡。而教诲巴帝摩卡只是专由诸佛所诵出的巴帝摩卡。
Among the three classifications above, virtue itself is the Pātimokkha. The Pātimokkha as text comprises the Bhikkhu Pātimokkha and the Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha, both of which belong to the authoritative Pātimokkha (āṇāpātimokkha). The instructional Pātimokkha (ovādapātimokkha) is recited exclusively by Buddhas.

第三节 巴帝摩卡的制定Section 3: Establishment of the Pātimokkha

制定包括巴帝摩卡在内的诸学处是拥有一切知智(sabbaññutā-ñāṇa)的正自觉者(sammā-sambuddha)的范畴，而不是其他诸如天人、人类、梵天、沙门、婆罗门等的能力范围，即使像沙利子(Sāriputta)尊者如此智慧第一的上首弟子(aggasāvaka)、伍巴离(Upāli)尊者如此持律第一的大弟子(mahāsāvaka)，都没有制戒的权限。
The laying down of training rules, including the Pātimokkha, belongs to the domain of a Fully Self-Awakened Buddha (sammā-sambuddha) who possesses omniscient knowledge (sabbaññutā-ñāṇa). It lies beyond the ability of devas, humans, brahmās, ascetics, brahmins, and others. Even Venerable Sāriputta, the chief disciple (aggasāvaka) foremost in wisdom, and Venerable Upāli, the great disciple (mahāsāvaka) foremost in knowledge of the Vinaya, had no authority to establish training rules.
在佛陀跋葛瓦弘法的最初二十年中，由于前来请求出家的人普遍动机纯正，僧团中还没有污垢法出现，所以佛陀跋葛瓦并没有为诸弟子们制定诸多的学处。当时，佛陀只是以“教诲巴帝摩卡”(Ovāda- pātimokkha)教导比库们。此“教诲巴帝摩卡”如下：
During the first twenty years of the Blessed One’s teaching career, those who requested the going forth generally had pure motives, and no corrupting conditions had yet appeared in the Saṅgha. The Blessed One therefore did not lay down many training rules for his disciples. At that time he instructed the bhikkhus only by means of the Exhortation Pātimokkha (Ovāda-pātimokkha), as follows:
Khantī paramaṃ tapo titikkhā,
nibbānaṃ paramaṃ vadanti buddhā.
Na hi pabbajito parūpaghātī,
na samaṇo hoti paraṃ viheṭhayanto.
Sabbapāpassa akaraṇaṃ,
kusalassa upasampadā.
Sacittapariyodapanaṃ,
etaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ.
Anūpavādo anūpaghāto,
pātimokkhe ca saṃvaro;
Mattaññutā ca bhattasmiṃ,
pantañca sayanāsanaṃ.
Adhicitte ca āyogo,
etaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ.
“忍耐是最高苦行，
“Patience is the supreme ascetic practice;
诸佛说涅槃最上；
the Buddhas declare Nibbāna to be supreme.
恼他实非出家人，
One who injures others is not truly gone forth;
害他者不是沙门。
one who harms another is not an ascetic.
莫作诸恶，
Do no evil,
具足于善；
cultivate what is wholesome,
净化自心，
purify one’s own mind—
此诸佛教。
this is the teaching of the Buddhas.
不责不恼害，
Do not insult or harm;
护巴帝摩卡；
practise restraint according to the Pātimokkha;
于食知节量，
be moderate in eating;
居边远住处；
dwell in a secluded place;
致力增上心，
be devoted to the higher mind—
此是诸佛教。”(D.2.90; Dhp.183-5; V.A.1.19)
this is the teaching of the Buddhas.” (D.2.90; Dhp.183–185; V.A.1.19)
据《律藏zàng》记载，佛陀跋葛瓦在证悟正自觉後的第十二年，住在韦沙离城(Vesālī)的韦兰迦村(Verañjā)度雨安居。在那时，上首弟子沙利子基于令佛陀教法久住的原因而希望跋葛瓦为弟子们制定学处，跋葛瓦说在僧团中还未出现有漏法之前不会为弟子们制定学处，诵巴帝摩卡。律中说：
According to the Vinaya Piṭaka, in the twelfth year after attaining Full Awakening, the Blessed One spent the rains retreat at Verañjā in Vesālī. At that time the chief disciple Sāriputta, wishing that the Buddha’s teaching might endure for a long time, asked the Blessed One to lay down training rules for his disciples. The Blessed One replied that he would not lay down training rules or recite the Pātimokkha until corrupting influences had appeared within the Saṅgha. The Vinaya states:
“那时，具寿6沙利子到僻静处独坐，心生如此想法:‘哪一位佛陀跋葛瓦的梵行不能久住？哪一位佛陀跋葛瓦的梵行能久住?’
“And then, when the sharikos sat alone in the middle of nowhere, they thought, “What is the Brahma in Buddha's the Blessed One that can't stay? Which Brahma in Buddha's the Blessed One can stay?”
当时，具寿沙利子在傍晚时分从禅坐起来，前往跋葛瓦之处。来到之後，顶礼跋葛瓦，坐在一边。坐在一边的具寿沙利子对跋葛瓦这样说：
And when he sat at night from Zen to the Blessed One's place, when he came, he sat at one side of the top of the Zone, and the one who sat at the other said to the Blessed One:
‘尊者，在此，我到僻静处独坐，心生如此想法:‘哪一位佛陀跋葛瓦的梵行不能久住？哪一位佛陀跋葛瓦的梵行能久住?’尊者，哪一位佛陀跋葛瓦的梵行不能久住？哪一位佛陀跋葛瓦的梵行能久住呢?’
`The Lord, I sit in a place of silence, and I wonder: `Who is the Brahma in the Buddha's District? Which Brahma in the Buddha's District? Who is the Brahma in the Buddha's District? Who is the Brahma in the Buddha's District? What is the Brahma in the Buddha's District?
‘沙利子，跋葛瓦维巴西(Vipassī)、跋葛瓦西奇(Sikhī)和跋葛瓦韦思菩(Vessabhu)的梵行不能久住。沙利子，跋葛瓦咖古三特(Kakusandha)、跋葛瓦果那葛马那(Konāgamana)和跋葛瓦咖沙巴(Kassapa)的梵行能久住。’
‘Sāriputta, the holy life under the Blessed Ones Vipassī, Sikhī, and Vessabhu did not last long. But the holy life under the Blessed Ones Kakusandha, Konāgamana, and Kassapa lasted a long time.’
‘尊者，是何因何缘，跋葛瓦维巴西、跋葛瓦西奇和跋葛瓦韦思菩的梵行不能久住呢?’
‘Why does the Lord, the Brahma of Gwawi Brazil, Gwacic and Gwaways not last?’
‘沙利子，跋葛瓦维巴西、跋葛瓦西奇和跋葛瓦韦思菩因疲劳为诸弟子详细说法，他们只有少量的经、应颂、记说、偈颂、感慨、如是语、本生、未曾有法与智得，不为诸弟子制定学处，不诵巴帝摩卡。当那些佛陀跋葛瓦入灭後，随佛觉悟的诸弟子入灭後，那些後来的弟子由不同名、不同姓、不同出身、不同种族出家，他们使其梵行迅速消失。
‘Sāriputta, the Blessed Ones Vipassī, Sikhī, and Vessabhu grew weary of teaching the Dhamma in detail to their disciples. They gave only a few discourses, mixed prose and verse, expositions, verses, inspired utterances, sayings, birth stories, amazing accounts, and catechetical teachings. They did not lay down training rules for their disciples or recite the Pātimokkha. After those Buddhas and their directly awakened disciples had attained final Nibbāna, later disciples who had gone forth from different names, clans, families, and social groups quickly caused the holy life to disappear.
沙利子，犹如不同的花放在木板上，不用线串在一起，那风一吹就飘散、分散、破碎。那是何因呢？它们没有被线串在一起故。同样地，沙利子，当那些佛陀跋葛瓦入灭後，随佛觉悟的诸弟子入灭後，那些後来的弟子由不同名、不同姓、不同出身、不同种族出家，他们使其梵行迅速消失。
As different flowers are placed on a plank, without a thread, the wind is scattered, scattered and broken. And why is that? And likewise, when the Buddha's guava was extinguished, the followers of Buddha's remembrance came to their homes with different names, different names, different origins, different races, and they quickly disappeared from their vanity.
又那些跋葛瓦疲劳以心查知弟子们之心。沙利子，过去韦思菩跋葛瓦、阿拉汉、正自觉者曾在一座恐怖的密林中，以心查知一千位比库僧之心，教诲、教诫[说]：应如此思惟，不应如此思惟；应如此作意，不应如此作意；应捨断此，应成就此而住。’沙利子，当时那一千位比库在韦思菩跋葛瓦、阿拉汉、正自觉者如此教诲、如此教诫时，心无执取而从诸漏解脱。沙利子，那座恐怖密林确实恐怖，若有未离贪者进入该密林，大多数皆毛骨悚然。沙利子，乃是此因此缘，跋葛瓦维巴西、跋葛瓦西奇和跋葛瓦韦思菩的梵行不能久住。’
And those who were tired and tired of the Blessed One should know the hearts of their disciples. The Saliko, who was in the past in the Wess Buddha's Land of the Blessed One, Arahan, and those who were conscious of themselves, had found out the heart of a thousand bhikkhus monks in a terrible forest, taught and taught [said]: "Thus should be thought, not so thought, not so thought, not so thought, not so thought, not so thought, and so should be done. "Sharako, that was why the 1,000 bhikkhus who were so taught by the Blessed One, Alahan, and those who were conscious of their own will, could not live long in the vanilla of Gwazi, Gwazi and Gwawess. "
‘尊者，又是何因何缘，跋葛瓦咖古三特、跋葛瓦果那葛马那和跋葛瓦咖沙巴的梵行能久住呢?’
‘What is the reason why the Sanctuary of Gorwagaku, Gewago, Gormana, and Gwadagashaba can live long?’
‘沙利子，跋葛瓦咖古三特、跋葛瓦果那葛马那和跋葛瓦咖沙巴不疲劳为诸弟子详细说法，他们[宣说]很多的经、应颂、记说、偈颂、感慨、如是语、本生、未曾有法与智得，为诸弟子制定学处、诵巴帝摩卡。当那些佛陀跋葛瓦入灭後，随佛觉悟的诸弟子入灭後，那些後来的弟子由不同名、不同姓、不同出身、不同种族出家，他们使其梵行长时住立。
‘Sāriputta, the Blessed Ones Kakusandha, Konāgamana, and Kassapa did not grow weary of teaching the Dhamma in detail to their disciples. They gave many discourses, mixed prose and verse, expositions, verses, inspired utterances, sayings, birth stories, amazing accounts, and catechetical teachings. They laid down training rules for their disciples and recited the Pātimokkha. After those Buddhas and their directly awakened disciples had attained final Nibbāna, later disciples who had gone forth from different names, clans, families, and social groups maintained the holy life for a long time.
沙利子，犹如不同的花放在木板上，用线串在一起，那风吹也不会飘散、分散、破碎。那是何因呢？它们被线串在一起故。同样地，沙利子，当那些佛陀跋葛瓦入灭後，随佛觉悟的诸弟子入灭後，那些後来的弟子由不同名、不同姓、不同出身、不同种族出家，他们使其梵行长时住立。沙利子，乃是此因此缘，跋葛瓦咖古三特、跋葛瓦果那格马那和跋葛瓦咖沙巴的梵行能久住。’
As different flowers are placed on a plank, the wind will not be scattered, scattered and broken. That is why. Likewise, the Shaleys, when the Buddha's guavas were destroyed, the followers of the Buddha's remembrance came to their homes with their names and surnames, their origins, their races, and they kept their fascists at home. That is why the Shaleys, for that reason, were able to live in the Sanskrits of Gwat, Gwagonamana and Zhuvatwat shabah.
当时，具寿沙利子即从座起，将上衣披于一肩，合掌礼敬跋葛瓦後，对跋葛瓦这样说：‘尊者，现在是时候了！善至，现在是时候了！愿跋葛瓦为诸弟子制定学处、诵巴帝摩卡，如此使此梵行长久住立。’
Then Venerable Sāriputta rose from his seat, arranged his upper robe over one shoulder, raised his joined palms in reverence toward the Blessed One, and said: ‘Venerable Sir, now is the time! Well-Gone One, now is the time! May the Blessed One lay down training rules for the disciples and recite the Pātimokkha so that this holy life may endure for a long time.’
‘你且等等，沙利子。你且等等，沙利子。如来将知其时。沙利子，只要在此某些有害之法尚未出现于僧团中，导师就不会为弟子们制定学处、诵巴帝摩卡。沙利子，只要在此某些有害之法出现于僧团中，那时导师才会为弟子们制定学处、诵巴帝摩卡，以便消除那些有害之法。
‘Wait, Sāriputta. Wait, Sāriputta. The Realized One will know the right time. So long as certain corrupting conditions have not appeared in the Saṅgha, the Teacher will not lay down training rules for the disciples or recite the Pātimokkha. When such corrupting conditions appear in the Saṅgha, the Teacher will lay down training rules and recite the Pātimokkha in order to eliminate them.
沙利子，只要僧团尚未达到阅历深者庞大之前，在此某些有害之法就还不会出现于僧团中。沙利子，只有僧团达到阅历深者庞大後，在此某些有害之法才会出现于僧团中，那时导师才会为弟子们制定学处、诵巴帝摩卡，以便消除那些有害之法。
Sāriputta, so long as the Saṅgha has not become large through long standing, corrupting conditions will not appear in it. Only when the Saṅgha has become large through long standing will such conditions appear; then the Teacher will lay down training rules for the disciples and recite the Pātimokkha in order to eliminate them.
沙利子，只要僧团尚未达到富裕庞大之前，在此某些有害之法还不会出现于僧团中。沙利子，只有僧团达到富裕庞大後，在此某些有害之法才会出现于僧团中，那时导师才会为弟子们制定学处、诵巴帝摩卡，以便消除那些有害之法。
Sāriputta, so long as the Saṅgha has not become large through material prosperity, corrupting conditions will not appear in it. Only when the Saṅgha has become large through material prosperity will such conditions appear; then the Teacher will lay down training rules for the disciples and recite the Pātimokkha in order to eliminate them.
沙利子，只要僧团尚未达到利得极丰庞大之前，在此某些有害之法还不会出现于僧团中。沙利子，只有僧团利得极丰庞大後，在此某些有害之法才会出现于僧团中，那时导师才会为诸弟子制定学处、诵巴帝摩卡，以便消除那些有害之法。
Sāriputta, so long as the Saṅgha has not become large through abundant gains, corrupting conditions will not appear in it. Only when the Saṅgha has become large through abundant gains will such conditions appear; then the Teacher will lay down training rules for the disciples and recite the Pātimokkha in order to eliminate them.
沙利子，只要僧团尚未达到多闻者庞大之前，在此某些有害之法还不会出现于僧团中。沙利子，只有僧团达到多闻者庞大後，在此某些有害之法才会出现于僧团中，那时导师才会为弟子们制定学处、诵巴帝摩卡，以便消除那些有害之法。
Sāriputta, so long as the Saṅgha has not become large through extensive learning, corrupting conditions will not appear in it. Only when the Saṅgha has become large through extensive learning will such conditions appear; then the Teacher will lay down training rules for the disciples and recite the Pātimokkha in order to eliminate them.
沙利子，比库僧团实无秽垢、无过患、离污浊、清净，安立心要。沙利子，此五百比库中，连最後的比库也是入流者，无堕处法，必定趣向正觉。’”(V.1.18-21)
Sāriputta, the Saṅgha of bhikkhus is free from stains and defects, purified and established in the essential qualities. Even the least advanced among these five hundred bhikkhus is a stream-enterer, no longer liable to rebirth in a bad destination and certain to attain Full Awakening.’ (V.1.18–21)
佛陀跋葛瓦住在韦沙离城大林(Mahāvana)的尖顶阁堂(Kūṭāgārasālā)。其时咖兰德村(Kalandagāma)的富豪子苏定那·咖兰德子(Sudinna Kalandaputta)闻佛说法，生起信心，请求出家，但父母坚决不允。苏定那乃采用绝食的方法，最终迫使其父母勉强答应。苏定那在跋葛瓦跟前出家并达上後，受持诸头陀行，并住在瓦基(Vajjī)的一个村庄。
The Blessed One was staying in the Great Wood (Mahāvana) at the Hall with the Peaked Roof (Kūṭāgārasālā) in Vesālī. At that time Sudinna Kalandaputta, the son of a wealthy family from Kalandagāma, heard the Buddha teach, gained faith, and asked permission to go forth. His parents firmly refused. Sudinna then fasted, and eventually compelled them to give their reluctant consent. After going forth and receiving the higher ordination in the Blessed One’s presence, he undertook ascetic practices and lived in a village in Vajjī.
有一次，瓦基发生饥馑，集食难得，具寿苏定那回乡托钵，被亲戚家的婢女认出。其父母知道後，邀请他次日回家应供。次日，其父母出示家财，诱劝具寿苏定那还俗，但再三不获其允，于是改求续种（子嗣）：“亲爱的苏定那啊！此家富有，大富大贵，多金银、多财物、多资产。亲爱的苏定那，那就请给予子嗣吧！不要让离差族人因为我们无子而没收财产。”具寿苏定那答应所求。其母携其前妻到大林中，由于当时跋葛瓦尚未制定学处，未能见到过患，于是苏定那和其前妻三次行淫欲法，他成为无秽垢、无过患的比库僧团中的最初犯戒者。
On one occasion there was a famine in Vajjī and almsfood was difficult to obtain. Venerable Sudinna returned to his home village on almsround and was recognized by a servant of his relatives. When his parents learned of this, they invited him to a meal the next day. They displayed the family wealth and repeatedly urged him to return to lay life, but he refused. They then asked him to provide an heir: ‘Dear Sudinna, this family is wealthy, very rich, with much gold, silver, property, and assets. Please provide an heir, so that the Licchavis do not confiscate our estate because we have no son.’ Venerable Sudinna agreed. His mother brought his former wife to the Great Wood. Since the Blessed One had not yet laid down a training rule and Sudinna did not see the danger, he had sexual intercourse with his former wife three times. He thus became the first offender in a Saṅgha that had previously been free of stains and defects.
苏定那的前妻因此有了身孕，不久生了个儿子，朋友们叫他“续种”(Bījaka)，称其母为“续种母”，称苏定那为“续种父”。之後，母子俩皆出家并证得阿拉汉。
As a result, Sudinna’s former wife became pregnant and later gave birth to a son. His companions called the boy ‘Bījaka’ (‘Seedling’), his mother ‘Bījaka’s mother’, and Sudinna ‘Bījaka’s father’. Mother and son later went forth and attained arahantship.
具寿苏定那事後常怀忧悔，告诉比库们，比库们种种呵责後报告跋葛瓦。跋葛瓦集合僧众审问具寿苏定那，以种种方式呵责後，制定了第一条学处：
Afterwards Venerable Sudinna was constantly distressed and remorseful. He told the bhikkhus what had happened. After reproaching him in many ways, they reported the matter to the Blessed One. The Blessed One assembled the Saṅgha, questioned Venerable Sudinna, reproached him in many ways, and then laid down the first training rule:
“若比库从事淫欲法者，是巴拉基格，不共住。”
“The man who committed the lewdness of Abigail is pārājika, who does not live together.”
跋葛瓦从此开始为比库们制定学处。(V.1.24-39)
From that time onward, the Blessed One began laying down training rules for bhikkhus. (V.1.24–39)
此後，随着僧团规模的不断扩大，僧人成份的不断复杂，在僧团中的不良现象和不良分子也逐渐增多。每当僧团出现污垢，或者比库们发生不适当的行为时，佛陀跋葛瓦就此因缘而制定了相应的学处。当制定的学处达到一定数量时，便编集成《巴帝摩卡》。
Thereafter, as the Saṅgha grew larger and its membership became more diverse, undesirable conduct and troublesome individuals gradually increased. Whenever a corrupting condition appeared in the Saṅgha or bhikkhus behaved improperly, the Blessed One laid down an appropriate training rule in response. When a sufficient number of rules had been established, they were compiled as the Pātimokkha.

第四节 制定巴帝摩卡的意义Section 4: Purpose of Establishing the Pātimokkha

佛陀跋葛瓦制定学处的一般过程是：僧团中有某位或某些比库发生不适当的行为，引起在家人的讥嫌、非议，比库们听到在家人的讥嫌、非议，其中的少欲者也讥嫌、非议。那些比库们以种种方法呵责後，将此事报告跋葛瓦。跋葛瓦因此集合僧众，将当事人叫到跟前查问。当事人承认事实後，跋葛瓦以种种方法呵责他，并申明制定学处的十项意义，然後制定学处：
The Blessed One’s usual procedure for laying down a training rule was as follows. One or more bhikkhus behaved improperly, provoking criticism and complaint from laypeople. After hearing those complaints, modest bhikkhus also criticized the conduct. They reproached the offenders in various ways and reported the matter to the Blessed One. The Blessed One assembled the Saṅgha, summoned and questioned the person concerned. Once the facts were admitted, he reproached the offender in various ways, stated the ten purposes for establishing a training rule, and then laid it down:
“Tena hi, Bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpessāmi dasa atthavase paṭicca - Saṅghasuṭṭhutāya, saṅghaphāsutāya, dummaṇkūnaṃ puggalānaṃ niggahāya, pesalānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ phāsuvihārāya, diṭṭhadhammikānaṃ āsavānaṃ saṃvarāya, samparāyikānaṃ āsavānaṃ paṭighātāya, appasannānaṃ pasādāya, pasannānaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya, saddhammaṭṭhitiyā, vinayānuggahāya.”
“诸比库，缘于十种 义利，我为比库们制定学处：为了僧团的优越，为了僧团的安乐；为了折服无耻之人，为了善行比库们的安住；为了防护现法诸漏，为了防止後世诸漏；为了无信者生信，为了已信者增长；为了正法住立，为了资益于律。”(V.1.39)
‘Bhikkhus, for ten benefits I lay down training rules for the bhikkhus: for the excellence of the Saṅgha; for the comfort of the Saṅgha; for restraining shameless persons; for the comfortable living of well-behaved bhikkhus; for restraining defilements pertaining to this life; for preventing defilements pertaining to future lives; for inspiring faith in those without faith; for increasing the faith of those who have faith; for the endurance of the true Dhamma; and for supporting the Vinaya.’ (V.1.39)
律藏zàng的义註《普端严》解释了这十种义利：
The Vinaya commentary Samantapāsādikā explains these ten benefits:
⑴僧团的优越：即是僧团的优越状态。凡是领受如来之语者，即能为他带来长久的利益、快乐，对于僧众们[回答]“好的，尊者!”来领受我的话而我将制定[学处]，并见到了不领受的过患以及领受的功德，而不是使用强硬手段，因此才这样显示说“为了僧团的优越”。
(1) The upper hand of the monks: that is, the upper hand of the monks. Anyone who receives a good word can bring him long-term benefit, happiness, and to the monks [responding] “good, honoured!” to receive my words, and I will make it clear that I have seen the pains and virtues of the monks, rather than using hard-line means, “for the benefit of the monks”.
⑵僧团的安乐：即是僧团安乐的状态。为了共同生活在一起者能够快乐地安住的意思。
(2) The rest of the monks: the rest of the monks. It means that those who live together can live happily.
⑶为了折服无耻之人：无耻即是恶戒之人7。即使对那些觉得羞耻的、会陷入痛苦的事，他在违犯时或做了也不会羞愧，为了折服他们。在没有学处时，他们会说“你们见到了什么？听到了什么？我们做了什么？凭哪件事、哪条罪来斥责我?”来扰乱僧团。但有了学处，僧团便可令他们见到学处而用法、律、导师之教来折服。以此故说：为了折服无耻之人。
(3) For restraining shameless persons: ‘shameless’ refers to those of bad conduct. Even when committing acts that would make a conscientious person ashamed and distressed, they feel no shame. Without training rules they might trouble the Saṅgha by saying, ‘What did you see? What did you hear? What have we done? On what matter and under which offence do you accuse me?’ Once training rules exist, the Saṅgha can point to the relevant rule and restrain them by means of the Dhamma, the Vinaya, and the Teacher’s instruction. Hence it is said, ‘for restraining shameless persons.’
⑷为了善行比库们的安住：为了善行、喜戒的比库们能够安乐住。若喜戒的比库不知道应作、不应作，有过失、无过失，界限和规则，在为圆满三学努力时感到疲劳，有疑问时感到苦恼。但若知道应作、不应作，有过失、无过失，界限和规则，在为圆满三学努力时不会疲劳，有疑问时不会苦恼。为他们制定学处则能导向安乐住。又或者折服了无耻之人，他们才能安乐住。若依止恶行之人，则不能行诵戒、不能作邀请8、不能举行僧甘马9，也不能和合，比库们不能专一地教导、询问和实践业处等。但折服了恶行者则没有这一切祸害，从而使善行比库们能安乐住。如此，当知“为了善行比库们的安住”有这两种意思。
(4) For the sake of the peace of the bhikkhus: for the sake of good deeds, and for the sake of joy, the bhikkhus can live in peace. If bhikkhus knows not what should be done, and should not be done, and there is no fault, no fault, boundaries and rules, he is tired and troubled in his efforts for the success of the three studies. But if he knows what should be done, should not be done, and there is no fault, no fault, no boundaries and rules, he does not fatigue himself in his efforts to complete the three studies, and in his doubt, he guides them in peace. If he does not know what to do with the evil, then he cannot recite, invite, or hold the monks and horses together. But the bhikkhus cannot teach, interrogate, interrogate, etc. But there is no such evil in their deeds, so that they may live well with the betters.
⑸为了防护现法诸漏10：现法诸漏即是因为不防护而使自身遭受到的拳打、棒打、砍手、砍脚、名声败坏、懊悔等痛苦。如是为了防护、避免、预防这些今生的灾患。
(5) For restraining defilements pertaining to this life: these are present-life sufferings that arise from lack of restraint, such as being punched, beaten with sticks, having one’s hands or feet cut off, loss of reputation, and remorse. The purpose is to guard against, avoid, and prevent such calamities in this life.
⑹为了防止後世诸漏：後世诸漏即是因为不防护而作了恶业之因，使後世遭受地狱等的痛苦。乃是为了消除、止灭、避免这些而说。
(6) In order to prevent the lapses of the hereafter, which are the cause of the evil that has been done in an unprotected manner, the torment of the hereafter, etc., is to be said in order to eliminate, eliminate, and avoid them.
⑺为了无信者生信：有了学处的制定，那些无信心但却知道学处的制定、或者见到比库们遵照学处而行的智者们会说：“对于世间上大多数人染着、秽恶、愚昧之事，这些沙门释迦子却能远离、离而安住，他们确实行难行之行，确实行重大之行。”从而生起信心，就像看了律藏zàng後的邪见者三吠陀婆罗门一样。所以说“为了无信者生信”。
(7) For the sake of the faithless: those wise men who have no confidence in its design but know its design, or who have seen bhikkhus follow it, will say: “For most people in the world who are exposed to it, they are obstinate and ignorant, and who are able to live far away and far away, they are indeed going hard to do it and do great things.” Thus, confidence is created, as is the case of the phantom of the phantom after the treachery. So it is said: “For the faithless, believe.”
⑻为了已信者增长：那些对佛教有信心的善男子知道了学处的制定，或见到比库们遵照学处而行时会说：“啊，这些聖尊是难行能行者，他们终生只吃一餐、行梵行、持守戒律防护。”从而信心越来越增长。以此故说“为了已信者增长”。11
(8) For increasing the faith of those who have faith: faithful people who learn that training rules have been established, or who see bhikkhus living in accordance with them, think, ‘How admirable! These venerable ones practise what is difficult: throughout their lives they eat only one meal a day, live the holy life, and maintain restraint through the discipline.’ Their confidence thereby grows. Hence it is said, ‘for increasing the faith of those who have faith.’
⑼为了正法住立：有三种正法：教正法(pariyatti saddhamma)、行正法(paṭipattisaddhamma)与证正法(adhigamasaddhamma)。在此，收录于三藏中的一切佛语名为“教正法”。十三种头陀功德、十四行仪、八十二大行仪，以及戒、定、观慧名为“行正法”。四种聖道、四种沙门果以及涅槃名为“证正法”。这一切都是因为有了学处的制定，比库们才能研习学处及其分别的义理、释义，连同其他佛语，并依所制定的学处修行。圆满行道後，因行道而证得应证悟的出世间法。所以，因制定了学处，才使正法得以长久地住立。以此故说“为了正法住立”。
(9) For the endurance of the true Dhamma: the true Dhamma is of three kinds—the true Dhamma of learning (pariyatti saddhamma), the true Dhamma of practice (paṭipattisaddhamma), and the true Dhamma of realization (adhigamasaddhamma). Here, all the Buddha’s words contained in the Tipiṭaka are called the true Dhamma of learning. The thirteen ascetic practices, the fourteen duties, the eighty-two major duties, and virtue, concentration, and insight are called the true Dhamma of practice. The four noble paths, the four fruits of recluseship, and Nibbāna are called the true Dhamma of realization. Because training rules were established, bhikkhus can study them, their analyses and explanations, and the rest of the Buddha’s teaching, and can practise in accordance with those rules. By fulfilling the practice, they realize the supramundane states that are to be realized. Thus the establishment of training rules enables the true Dhamma to endure. This is why it is said, ‘for the endurance of the true Dhamma.’
⑽为了资益于律：有了学处的制定，可以资益、支持、巩固防护律、捨断律、止律和制定律四种律12，以此故说“为了资益于律”。
(10) For supporting the Vinaya: by establishing training rules, the four aspects of the Vinaya—the discipline of restraint, abandoning, cessation, and regulation—are supported, maintained, and strengthened. Hence it is said, ‘for supporting the Vinaya.’
所有诸句皆可结合“我将制定学处”这一语。比如第一句和最後一句可组合为：“为了僧团的优越，我将制定学处；为了资益于律，我将制定学处。”
Each of these expressions may be joined to the phrase ‘I shall lay down a training rule’. For example, the first and last may be read: ‘For the excellence of the Saṅgha, I shall lay down a training rule; for supporting the Vinaya, I shall lay down a training rule.’
此外也可用“僧团的优越即是僧团的安乐；僧团的安乐即能折服无耻之人”等环环相扣的方法，如此以“僧团的优越即是僧团的安乐；僧团的安乐即能折服无耻之人”等每一句为基础而连结十次。
It can also be linked ten times, on the basis of each sentence, such as “the upper hand of the monks, i.e. the comfort of the monks, the comfort of the monks, the comfort of the shameless”, and so on.

第五节 比库巴帝摩卡的内容Section 5: Contents of the Bhikkhupātimokkha

在聖典中，跋葛瓦谈到持戒时经常这样强调：
In the canonical texts, when speaking about the observance of virtue, the Blessed One frequently emphasized:
“Sampannasīlā, bhikkhave, viharatha sampanna- pātimokkhā, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvutā viharatha, ācāragocarasampannā, aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvino; samādāya sikkhatha sikkhāpadesu.”
“诸比库，要具足戒与具足巴帝摩卡而住，防护巴帝摩卡防护、具足正行与行处而住，见到微细罪过的危险，受持诸学处而学。”
‘Bhikkhus, dwell accomplished in virtue and accomplished in the Pātimokkha. Dwell restrained by the restraint of the Pātimokkha, accomplished in good conduct and proper resort. Seeing danger in the slightest fault, undertake and train in the training rules.’
在《清净之道》中也提到，作为禅修基础的戒清净包括四种清净戒：
It is also mentioned in the Clean News that the clean-up, which forms the basis of rehab, consists of four clean-up measures:
1. 巴帝摩卡防护戒(pātimokkhasaṃvara-sīla)，即比库应当守护的各种学处、律仪。
1. Virtue of restraint by the Pātimokkha (pātimokkhasaṃvara-sīla): the various training rules and restraints that a bhikkhu must observe.
2. 根防护戒(indriyasaṃvara-sīla)，根即感官；守护好眼、耳、鼻、舌、身、意六根门称为根防护。
2. Virtue of sense-faculty restraint (indriyasaṃvara-sīla): guarding the six sense doors—the eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind.
3. 活命清净戒(ājīvapārisuddhi-sīla)，即依正命（正确的谋生方式）而活，不能邪命自活。
3. Virtue consisting in purity of livelihood (ājīvapārisuddhi-sīla): living by right livelihood and not supporting oneself through wrong livelihood.
4. 资具依止戒(paccayasannissita-sīla)，即正确、适当地使用生活必需品，包括袈裟、饮食、住所、医药等生活用品。
4. Virtue concerning the proper use of requisites (paccayasannissita-sīla): using life’s necessities correctly and appropriately, including robes, food, lodging, and medicines.
因此，巴帝摩卡属于比库的主要学处之一。
As a result, Pātimokkha is one of the main departments of bhikkhus.
这里的“学处”，巴利语sikkhāpada，又译作学足。sikkhā意为学、学习、训练；pada意为足、处所。学处亦即是学习规则、行为规范、戒条。
Here, ‘training rule’ is sikkhāpada in Pāli, also rendered literally as a ‘basis of training’. Sikkhā means learning, study, or training; pada means a footing, basis, or place. A sikkhāpada is therefore a rule of training, a standard of conduct, or a precept.
在《小诵义註》中说：
In the Little Recitation, it says:
“Sikkhitabbā'ti sikkhā, pajjate anenāti padaṃ. Sikkhāya padaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ, sikkhāya adhigamūpāyoti attho. Atha vā mūlaṃ nissayo patiṭṭhāti vuttaṃ hoti.”
“应当学故为学；以此作为足故为足。学之足为学足，即到达学的方法之义。又或者说为根本、依止、立足处[为学处]。”(Khp.A.p.15)
“Students should be learned for good; they should be sufficient. The learning should be sufficient, i.e. the means of reaching it. Or fundamental, stop and [suspension].” (Khp.A.p. 15)
比库巴帝摩卡一共包括227条学处。这些学处又可以分为八法，即：
The Bhikkhu Pātimokkha comprises 227 training rules, classified into eight categories:
1. 巴拉基格法：4条；
1. Four rules entailing expulsion (pārājika);
2. 桑喀地谢思法：13条；
2. Thirteen rules entailing suspension (saṅghādisesa);
3. 不定法：2条；
3. Two undetermined rules (aniyata);
4. 尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚法：30条；
4. Thirty rules entailing relinquishment and confession (nissaggiya pācittiya);
5. 巴吉帝亚法：92条；
5. Ninety-two rules entailing confession (pācittiya);
6. 应悔过法：4条；
6. Four rules entailing acknowledgment (pāṭidesanīya);
7. 应学法：75条；
7. Seventy-five rules of training (sekhiya);
8. 止争法：7条。
8. Seven principles for settling legal issues (adhikaraṇasamatha).
一、巴拉基格
I. Rules entailing expulsion (Pārājika)
巴拉基格：巴利语pārājika的音译，梵语同。直译为“他胜”，意为已被打败或失败。13
Pārājika is a transliteration of the Pāli pārājika; the Sanskrit form is the same. It literally means ‘defeated’ and indicates defeat or failure.
在《巴拉基格》中说：
In pārājika, it says:
“Pārājiko hotī'ti seyyathāpi nāma puriso sīsacchinno abhabbo tena sasīrabandhanena jīvituṃ, evameva bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo. Tena vuccati - pārājiko hotī'ti.”
“是巴拉基格者，犹如有人的头被砍断了，不可能再和他的身体连接而活命。同样地，比库从事淫欲法後，即非沙门、非释迦子。因此称为巴拉基格。”(V.1.55)
‘One who has committed a pārājika offence is like a person whose head has been cut off and who cannot live by having it rejoined to the body. In the same way, after engaging in sexual intercourse, a bhikkhu is no longer an ascetic or a son of the Sakyan. Therefore he is called one who is expelled.’ (V.1.55)
在《附随》中说：
In the Annex, it is stated:
“Pārājikan'ti yaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ suṇohi yathātathaṃ.
cuto paraddho bhaṭṭho ca, saddhammā hi niraṅkato;
saṃvāsopi tahiṃ natthi, tenetaṃ iti vuccati.”
“所谓‘巴拉基格’者，请听如实说：
‘As for what is called pārājika, listen to its exact meaning:
从正法中死去、失败、堕落和弃绝，
dead to the true Dhamma, defeated, fallen, and excluded;
不与他共住，因此如是说。”(V.5.339)
there is no communion with him; therefore it is so called.’ (V.5.339)
巴拉基格相当于比库的极刑。在《大分别》中把巴拉基格比喻为断了头之人不可能再和身体接合而活命、枯叶从树枝上飘落後不可能再变回绿叶、石头破成两块就无法再复合、棕榈树的顶部被砍断了就无法再生长。同样地，凡比库违犯了此学处即自动丧失比库的身份，并且不得与僧团共住，当生也不能再受戒成为比库。若违犯者不隐瞒自己的过失，在违犯之後立刻脱掉袈裟，换成俗人的衣服，将来若想再出家，还可以受戒成为沙马内勒；然而，如果他在犯了巴拉基格罪後仍然继续保持原来的形象，冒充为比库，则他既不是比库，当生也不能再出家。
A pārājika offence is the monastic equivalent of capital punishment. The Mahāvibhaṅga compares it to a person whose severed head cannot be rejoined to the body and restored to life, a withered leaf that cannot become green again after falling from a branch, a stone split in two that cannot be made whole again, and a palm tree whose crown has been cut off and cannot grow again. In the same way, a bhikkhu who commits any of these training rules automatically loses bhikkhu status, may no longer live in communion with the Saṅgha, and cannot receive the higher ordination again in that lifetime. If the offender does not conceal the offence, immediately removes the robes, and changes into lay clothes, he may later go forth again as a sāmaṇera. But if, after committing a pārājika offence, he keeps up the appearance of a bhikkhu and impersonates one, he is no longer a bhikkhu and cannot go forth again in that lifetime.
共有四条巴拉基格罪：
There are four pārājika offences:
1. 淫欲法
1. Sexual intercourseSC
2. 不与取
2. StealingSC
3. 故意杀人
3. Killing a human beingSC
4. 说虚妄的上人法。
4. Falsely claiming a superhuman qualitySC
假如一位比库和人或动物发生性行为，或偷盗价值为五马萨（māsaka,古印度的货币单位）或以上的物品，或故意杀人，或以欺骗之心说了虚假的上人法，他即犯了巴拉基格。
If a bhikkhu has sexual intercourse with a human being or an animal, steals an item worth five māsakas (an ancient Indian unit of currency) or more, intentionally kills a human being, or deceitfully makes a false claim to a superhuman quality, he commits a pārājika offence.
二、桑喀地谢思
II. Rules entailing suspension (Saṅghādisesa)
桑喀地谢思：巴利语saṅghādisesa的音译，直译作“僧始终”。其由saṅgha（僧团）+ ādi（最初；开始；首先）+ sesa（残馀；剩馀；剩下）三词组合而成。意谓犯了此一类学处的比库，对其罪的处理过程自始至终皆须由僧团来执行。14
Saṅghādisesa is a transliteration of the Pāli saṅghādisesa and may be rendered literally as ‘involving the Saṅgha from beginning to end’. It is composed of saṅgha (the monastic community), ādi (the beginning or first), and sesa (the remainder or what is left). A bhikkhu who commits this class of offence must have the entire disciplinary process carried out by the Saṅgha from beginning to end.
在《大分别》中解释说：
In the Major Division it is explained that:
“Saṅghādiseso'ti saṅghova tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ deti, mūlāya paṭikassati deti, mānattaṃ deti, abbheti; na sambahulā, na ekapuggalo. Tena vuccati - saṅghādiseso'ti.”
“桑喀地谢思者，唯有僧团才能对其罪给与别住，给与退回原本15，给与敬悦16及令出罪，非多人，非一人[所能作]，因此称为‘桑喀地谢思’。”(V.1.237)
‘For a saṅghādisesa offence, only the Saṅgha can impose probation, send the offender back to the beginning, grant mānatta, and rehabilitate him. Neither a group nor one individual can do so. Therefore it is called saṅghādisesa.’ (V.1.237)
在《附随》中也说：
In the Annex, it is also stated:
“Saṅghādiseso'ti yaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ suṇohi yathātathaṃ.
saṅghova deti parivāsaṃ, mūlāya paṭikassati;
mānattaṃ deti abbheti, tenetaṃ iti vuccati.”
“所谓‘桑喀地谢思’者，请听如实说：
‘As for what is called saṅghādisesa, listen to its exact meaning:
唯有僧团才能给与别住、退回原本、
only the Saṅgha gives probation and sends the offender back to the beginning;
给与敬悦及令出罪，因此如是说。”(V.5.339)
the Saṅgha grants mānatta and rehabilitates him; therefore it is so called.’ (V.5.339)
违犯这一类学处者，虽然还不至于失去比库的资格，但为了恢复作为正常比库身份，他必须经历坦白至出罪的一系列程序——从最初的履行敬悦至最後的出罪，皆须由僧团来执行，而非个人或数人所能执行。如果比库在犯了其中任何一条学处之後，即应向一位或多位比库坦白他的罪行。如果犯戒者明知而隐瞒该罪行多少天，在忏罪前还必须依其隐瞒的天数来行别住(parivāsa)多少天。行别住之後，他应当通知一个至少有四位比库的僧团，向僧团请求实行为期六夜的敬悦。履行敬悦之後，犯戒比库应再向至少有二十位清净比库的僧团请求出罪(abbhana)。如果在不满二十位比库的僧团为这个比库出罪，即使才少一位，该比库也无法出罪。从履行别住到出罪期间，犯戒比库有94项僧权被中止。经出罪後，该比库才恢复正常比库的身份。
A bhikkhu who commits an offence of this class does not lose bhikkhu status, but to regain his normal standing he must undergo a sequence of procedures from confession through rehabilitation. From the initial observance of mānatta to final rehabilitation, the procedures must be carried out by the Saṅgha, not by one person or a small group. After committing any such offence, a bhikkhu should confess it to one or more bhikkhus. If he knowingly concealed it for a certain number of days, he must first undergo probation (parivāsa) for the same number of days. After probation, he must notify a Saṅgha of at least four bhikkhus and request six nights of mānatta. After completing mānatta, he must request rehabilitation (abbhana) from a Saṅgha of at least twenty pure bhikkhus. If even one of the required twenty is missing, rehabilitation is invalid. During the period from probation to rehabilitation, ninety-four privileges of a bhikkhu are suspended. Only after rehabilitation does he regain normal bhikkhu status.
共有十三条桑喀地谢思罪：
There are thirteen saṅghādisesa offences:
1. 故意出精
1. MasturbationSC
2. 触摸女人
2. Physical contact with a womanSC
3. 对女人说粗俗语
3. Indecent speechSC
4. 向女人赞叹以淫欲侍奉自己
4. Encouraging a woman to satisfy one’s desiresSC
5. 做媒
5. MatchmakingSC
6. 建无主孤邸
6. Building a hut inappropriatelySC
7. 建大住所
7. Building a dwelling inappropriatelySC
8. 以无根据巴拉基格诽谤
8. Making a groundless accusation out of angerSC
9. 取类似事情的巴拉基格诽谤
9. Making a groundless accusation out of anger, using a pretextSC
10. 分裂僧团
10. Causing a schism in the SanghaSC
11. 追随分裂僧团
11. Siding with a schismaticSC
12. 不受劝告
12. Being difficult to correctSC
13. 污家不受驱摈
13. Being a corrupter of familiesSC
对于此十三桑喀地谢思法，前面九条学处只需做一次即犯，後面四条学处则须经劝告三次才犯。
For these thirteen saṅghādisesa rules, the first nine are infringed by a single act, whereas the last four are infringed only after the bhikkhu has been formally admonished three times.
三、不定
III. Undetermined rules (Aniyata)
不定 (aniyata)：是指尚未确定比库所违犯的是属于巴拉基格、桑喀地谢思或巴吉帝亚三者之中的哪一种罪行的学处。
An undetermined rule (aniyata) concerns conduct for which it has not yet been determined whether the bhikkhu has committed an offence of pārājika, saṅghādisesa, or pācittiya.
在《大分别》中解释说：
In the Major Division it is explained that:
“Aniyato'ti na niyato pārājikaṃ vā saṅghādiseso vā pācittiyaṃ vā.”
“不定者，即不确定是巴拉基格、桑喀地谢思或巴吉帝亚。”(V.1.450)
‘Undetermined means that it is not determined whether the offence is pārājika, saṅghādisesa, or pācittiya.’ (V.1.450)
在《附随》中说：
In the Annex, it is stated:

“所谓‘不定’者，请听如实说：
“As for the so-called `uncertainty', please be honest:
不定即不确定，乃不确定三者中，
undetermined means not determined, an expression uncertain among three possibilities;
其中一处之语，称为‘不定’。”(V.5.339)
when it is fixed as one of those three cases, it is called “undetermined”.’ (V.5.339)
若比库和女人单独坐在秘密隐蔽处或偏僻处时，被说话值得信赖的信徒看见，于是应根据比库自己承认，或根据该信徒的控告来惩治。如果行淫，则犯巴拉基格(第1)；若身体相接触或说粗俗语，则构成桑喀地谢思(第2或第3)；若只是和女人单独共坐，则犯巴吉帝亚(第44或45)。因罪行不确定，故名“不定”。
If a trustworthy lay follower sees a bhikkhu sitting alone with a woman in a concealed private place or a secluded place, the case is to be dealt with according to the bhikkhu’s own admission or the lay follower’s allegation. Sexual intercourse entails pārājika offence 1; physical contact or indecent speech entails saṅghādisesa offence 2 or 3; merely sitting alone with a woman entails pācittiya offence 44 or 45. Because the class of offence is not yet determined, these rules are called ‘undetermined’.

尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚：巴利语nissaggiya pācittiya的音译。尼萨耆亚(nissaggiya)，意为应捨弃的；巴吉帝亚(pācittiya)，意为令心堕落。17
Nissaggiya pācittiya is a transliteration of the Pāli. Nissaggiya means ‘to be relinquished’, and pācittiya means ‘causing the mind to fall’.
在《附随》中说：
In the Annex, it is stated:

“所谓‘尼萨耆亚’者，请听如实说：
“As for the so-called `Nisamia', please be honest:
在僧团中间、众人中间或只在一人前，
In the midst of the monks, among the people, or in front of only one man,
捨弃之後再忏悔，因此如是说。”(V.5.339)
Repent after abandoning, so say so.” (V.5.339)

VI. RETURNING

Acknowledgment (pāṭidesanīya): the term means that a bhikkhu’s conduct is blameworthy and must be acknowledged or confessed.
在《附随》中说：
In the Annex, it is stated:

sāmaṃ gahetvā bhuñjeyya, gārayhan'ti pavuccati.

anivāretvā tahiṃ bhuñje, gārayhanti pavuccati.

agilāno tahiṃ bhuñje, gārayhanti pavuccati.

“所谓‘应悔过’者，请听如实说：

比库从非亲戚、难以获得的食物，

七、应学法
VII. Rules of training (Sekhiya)
应学(sekhiya)：即应当学习的行仪。
Sekhiya: the instrument that should be studied.
《疑惑度脱》中解释说：
As explained in The Disquiet:
“Ettha ca yasmā vattakkhandhake vuttavattānipi sikkhitabbattā sekhiyāneva honti.”
“因为对此[学处]和在<行仪篇>中所说的诸行仪都应当学习故，乃为应学。”(Kv.p.278)
‘Because both these training rules and the duties stated in the Duties Khandhaka must be trained in, they are called sekhiya.’ (Kv.p.278)
在《附随》中说：
In the Annex, it is stated:
“Sekhiyan'ti yaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ suṇohi yathātathaṃ;
sekkhassa sikkhamānassa, ujumaggānusārino.
Ādi cetaṃ caraṇañca, mukhaṃ saññamasaṃvaro;
sikkhassa etādisī natthi, tenetaṃ iti vuccati.”
“所谓‘应学’者，请听如实说：
“As for the so-called `academics', please be honest:
对随正直之道而行的学者正在学习的，
For what scholars who follow the path of integrity are learning.
这是最初的行为，以及自制防护之门，
It's the first act and the door to homemade protection.
没有[其它]学像这样，因此如是说。”(V.5.339)
No [other] studies like this, so say so.” (V.5.339)
这一类学处主要是关于比库行止威仪的规定。这一类学处并不象其它“止持”学处一样，采用说出罪名的方式，即“若比库……者，犯恶作”，而是在学处之後加上“应当学”(sikkhā karaṇīya)，这显示了此类学处乃属于“作持”的范畴，即“应当如此作”之义。比库只有以不恭敬的态度违犯这一类学处，才犯恶作罪。
These training rules mainly govern a bhikkhu’s deportment. Unlike other prohibitive rules, they do not state an offence in the form ‘If a bhikkhu …, he commits an offence of wrong conduct.’ Instead, each rule concludes with ‘this is how one should train’ (sikkhā karaṇīya). This shows that they are observances to be actively practised—that is, ‘one should act in this way’. A bhikkhu commits an offence of wrong conduct only when he violates one of these rules disrespectfully.

八、七止争法
VIII. Seven principles for settling legal issues
七止争法(satta adhikaraṇasamathā dhammā)是用来止息僧团争事的七种方法：
The seven principles for settling legal issues (satta adhikaraṇasamathā dhammā) are seven methods for resolving disputes within the Saṅgha:
1. 现前调伏
1. Resolution face-to-face
