第六节 学处与罪Section 6: Training Rules and Offences

如果比库违犯了此227条学处，将依不同的违犯程度而构成七种罪。此七种罪从重至轻依次为：
If a bhikkhu violates any of these 227 training rules, the seriousness of the violation determines which of the following seven classes of offence is incurred, listed here from the most serious to the least serious:
1. 巴拉基格(pārājika)；
1. Pārājika (pārājika), an offence entailing expulsion;
2. 桑喀地谢思(saṅghādisesa)；
2. Saṅghādisesa (saṅghādisesa), an offence entailing suspension;
3. 土喇吒亚(thullaccaya, 粗罪)；
3. Thullaccaya (thullaccaya), a grave offence;
4. 巴吉帝亚(pācittiya)；
4. Pācittiya (pācittiya), an offence entailing confession;
5. 应悔过(pāṭidesanīya)；
5. Pāṭidesanīya (pāṭidesanīya), an offence entailing acknowledgment;
6. 恶作(dukkaṭa)，即不好的行为；
6. Dukkaṭa (dukkaṭa), an offence of wrong conduct;
7. 恶说(dubbhāsita, 不好的言语) 。
7. Dubbhāsita (dubbhāsita), an offence of wrong speech.
当知学处(sikkhāpada)与罪(āpatti)是有所不同的。“学处”相当于戒条，皆为佛陀所制定，是每一位弟子都应当持守的。“罪”则是由于持戒者有意或无意违犯了学处而构成的过错。
A training rule (sikkhāpada) and an offence (āpatti) are different. A training rule is a precept established by the Buddha that every disciple should observe. An offence is the fault incurred when an observer intentionally or unintentionally violates a training rule.
例如巴拉基格学处的第二条为“不与取”，假如比库企图偷取他人的贵重物品，碰触到即犯恶作，移动犯土喇吒亚，物品离开原处即犯巴拉基格。
For example, the second pārājika training rule concerns taking what has not been given. If a bhikkhu intends to steal another person’s valuable property, touching it incurs an offence of wrong conduct, moving it incurs a grave offence, and removing it from its original place incurs a pārājika offence.
第三条为“故意杀人”，假如比库企图杀人，在为杀人做准备工作时犯恶作，当受害者感到痛苦时犯土喇吒亚，若受害者因此死亡即犯巴拉基格。
The third pārājika training rule concerns intentionally killing a human being. If a bhikkhu intends to kill someone, he incurs an offence of wrong conduct while preparing to do so, a grave offence when the victim experiences pain, and a pārājika offence if the victim dies as a result.
又如巴吉帝亚第四十条学处“吃未授与的食物”，假如比库为了吃未经授与的食物而拿取者，犯恶作；每吞咽一口，皆犯一巴吉帝亚。
Similarly, under the fortieth pācittiya training rule, ‘eating food that has not been given’, a bhikkhu who takes food intending to eat it before it has been given incurs an offence of wrong conduct; each mouthful he swallows incurs a pācittiya offence.
因此，对于同一条学处，将会根据不同程度的违犯而构成轻重不同的罪过。对于四条巴拉基格学处，只有在具足所有违犯条件的情况下才构成巴拉基格罪，而且最高的罪行即是巴拉基格；若缺少一两项条件，则可能犯较轻的罪，甚至不犯。对于桑喀地谢思罪、尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚罪、巴吉帝亚罪、应悔过罪等也依此类推。不过，对于应学法，故意违犯任何一条学处皆只构成恶作罪。
Thus a single training rule may give rise to offences of different gravity according to the degree of violation. Under the four pārājika rules, a pārājika offence is incurred only when every required condition is fulfilled. If one or two conditions are absent, a lesser offence—or no offence—may result. The same principle applies to saṅghādisesa, nissaggiya pācittiya, pācittiya, and pāṭidesanīya offences. For the sekhiya rules, however, intentionally violating any rule incurs only an offence of wrong conduct.
对于比库违犯跋葛瓦所制定的学处，依其罪过的种类又可分为以下几种：
Offences arising from a bhikkhu’s violation of training rules established by the Blessed One may also be classified as follows:
一、重罪与轻罪
I. Grave and light offences
1.重罪(garukāpatti)有两种，即：
1. Grave offences (garukāpatti) are of two kinds:
⑴巴拉基格：不可忏之罪(atekicchā)；
(1) Pārājika: an offence that cannot be remedied (atekicchā);
⑵桑喀地谢思：可忏之罪(satekicchā)，违犯此罪者先须坦白其罪，并经僧团的一系列处分後才能恢复清净。
(2) Saṅghādisesa: a remediable offence (satekicchā). The offender must first confess it and then undergo a series of formal procedures by the Saṅgha before purity is restored.
2.轻罪(lahukāpatti)有五种，属于可忏之罪，即：
2. Light offences (lahukāpatti) are five remediable classes:
⑴土喇吒亚；
(1) Thullaccaya;
⑵巴吉帝亚；
(2) Pācittiya;
⑶应悔过；
(3) Pāṭidesanīya;
⑷恶作；
(4) Dukkaṭa;
⑸恶说。
(5) Dubbhāsita.
违犯这五种轻罪的比库，只需向另一位比库坦白其罪，然後进行忏悔即可恢复清净。
A bhikkhu who incurs one of these five light offences need only confess it to another bhikkhu and perform the appropriate acknowledgment to restore purity.
二、有心罪与无心罪
II. Offences involving intention and offences not requiring intention
1.有心罪(sacittaka)：通过故意（有心）违犯学处才构成的罪过。有些学处必须通过故意违犯才构成罪过，若非故意则不犯。如故意杀人犯巴拉基格，故意杀害生命犯巴吉帝亚等。
1. An offence involving intention (sacittaka) is incurred only through an intentional violation of a training rule. Some offences require intention: if the act is unintentional, no offence is incurred. Examples include a pārājika offence for intentionally killing a human being and a pācittiya offence for intentionally killing a living being.
2.无心罪(acittaka)：无意违犯之罪。有些学处即使无意违犯，只要符合违犯的条件也会构成罪。如施主将金钱装进袋中供养比库，比库误认为是如法物品而接受，也构成违犯尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
2. An offence not requiring intention (acittaka) may be incurred even without an intention to violate the rule, provided the other conditions are fulfilled. For example, if a donor puts money into a bag as an offering and a bhikkhu accepts it believing it to contain allowable goods, he still incurs a nissaggiya pācittiya offence.
三、由想得脱与非由想得脱
III. Offences from which one is freed by perception and offences from which one is not freed by perception
1.由想得脱之罪(saññāvimokkhā)：由于没有违犯学处之想而得以逃脱的罪过。这种罪是指无意违犯有心罪而言。
1. An offence from which one is freed by perception (saññāvimokkhā): if the person has no perception that would make the act a violation, the offence is not incurred. This refers to an unintentional act in relation to an offence that requires intention.
2.非由想得脱之罪(nosaññāvimokkhā)：不管有没有违犯学处之想，只要符合违犯的条件都不能逃脱的罪过。这种罪过是指故意违犯有心罪和违犯无心罪而言。
2. An offence from which one is not freed by perception (nosaññāvimokkhā): whether or not the person perceives the act as a violation, the offence is incurred whenever its conditions are fulfilled. This includes intentionally committing an offence that requires intention and committing an offence that does not require intention.
四、世间罪与制定罪
IV. Naturally blameworthy offences and offences established by regulation
1.世间罪(lokavajja)：生起不善心故意违犯的行为，或者社会上普遍认为是不合乎道德的行为。有些行为不仅对比库、比库尼而言是不能做的，即使对世俗普通人来说也是不道德的行为。如故意杀人、不与取、说虚妄语等。
1. A naturally blameworthy offence (lokavajja) is an intentional act rooted in an unwholesome state of mind, or conduct generally regarded by society as immoral. Such actions are wrong not only for bhikkhus and bhikkhunīs but also for laypeople—for example, intentionally killing, stealing, and lying.
2.制定罪(paṇṇattivajja)：由跋葛瓦所制定、只是针对比库、比库尼违犯才构成的罪过。有些学处只是规定比库、比库尼才不能违越，但是世俗普通人造作并不会构成罪过。如接受金钱、从事买卖、挖掘土地等。
2. An offence established by regulation (paṇṇattivajja) is an offence because it has been laid down by the Blessed One specifically for bhikkhus and bhikkhunīs. Certain acts are prohibited only for monastics and are not considered offences when performed by ordinary laypeople—for example, accepting money, engaging in trade, or digging soil.
五、身业、语业与身语业
V. Offences by bodily action, verbal action, or both
1.身业罪(kāyakamma)：通过身体行为违犯的罪过。如从事淫欲法、故意出精、触摸女人等。
1. An offence by bodily action (kāyakamma) is committed through physical conduct—for example, engaging in sexual intercourse, intentionally emitting semen, or touching a woman.
2.语业罪(vacīkamma)：通过语言违犯的罪过。如和未达上者同句诵法、对女人说法过限等。
2. An offence by verbal action (vacīkamma) is committed through speech—for example, reciting the Dhamma line by line with a person who has not received the higher ordination, or teaching a woman beyond the permitted limit.
3.身业和语业罪(kāyakammaṃ vacīkammañca)：能通过身体行为和语言两者违犯的罪过。如不与取、故意杀人、说虚妄的上人法等。
3. An offence by both bodily and verbal action (kāyakammaṃ vacīkammañca) may be committed through either physical conduct or speech—for example, stealing, intentionally killing a human being, or falsely claiming a superhuman quality.
须知并没有纯粹由意门（心念）构成的犯戒。21
It should be understood that no breach of a training rule is committed solely through the mind door—that is, by thought alone.

第七节 伍波思特的起源Section 7: Origin of the Uposatha

佛教僧团有每隔半个月念诵《巴帝摩卡》戒经的传统。因此，僧团诵戒称为“伍波思特”。
The Buddhist monks have a tradition of reading the Book of Pātimokkha every half month. Thus, the monks are called “Uposatha”.
伍波思特，巴利语uposatha的音译。该词源于梵语upavasatha。若依音义法来解释，upavasatha 由 upa(近，随) + vas(住) + atha组成，直译为“近住”，即在特定的日子里持斋戒的意思。22
Uposatha is a transliteration of the Pāli uposatha, derived from the Sanskrit upavasatha. Etymologically, upavasatha may be analysed as upa (‘near’ or ‘with’) + vas (‘to dwell’) + atha. It literally means ‘dwelling near’ and refers to observing a fast or religious observance on a designated day.
义註中如此解释“伍波思特”：
The commentaries explain Uposatha as follows:
“‘于此日近住’为伍波思特。近住是以持戒或禁食作为具足而住之意。在此举出一些意思：‘来，贤友咖比那，我们去伍波思特吧’等为诵巴帝摩卡的伍波思特。‘维萨卡，如此以八支具足而住于伍波思特’(增5.43)等为戒。‘二月确实常清净，伍波思特常清净’(M.1. 79)等为持戒。‘龙王名叫伍波思特’(D.2.246)等是名称。‘诸比库，不得在伍波思特当天从有比库的住处[前往无比库的住处]’(V.3.181)等为应近住之日；这才是这里的意思。由于它可分为八日、十四日、十五日三种，所以排除了其馀两种而说在十五日。由此而说:‘于此日近住’为伍波思特。”(D.A.1.150; M.A.3.85)
‘“Dwelling near on this day” is Uposatha. “Dwelling near” means dwelling accomplished in virtue or fasting. Several usages may be distinguished. “Come, friend Kappina, let us go to the Uposatha” and similar passages refer to the Uposatha at which the Pātimokkha is recited. “Visākhā, in this way one dwells observing the Uposatha endowed with eight factors” (A.5.43) and similar passages refer to precepts. “The fortnight is indeed always pure; the Uposatha is always pure” (M.1.79) and similar passages refer to observance. “The nāga king named Uposatha” (D.2.246) is a proper name. “Bhikkhus, on an Uposatha day one should not leave a residence with bhikkhus for a residence without bhikkhus” (V.3.181) and similar passages refer to the day on which one should observe. This last meaning is intended here. Since observance days may fall on the eighth, fourteenth, or fifteenth, the other two are excluded and the fifteenth is stated. Hence “dwelling near on this day” is called Uposatha.’ (D.A.1.150; M.A.3.85)
综合上述义註的解释，伍波思特有三种意思：
Taken together, the commentarial explanations give Uposatha three meanings:
1. 一个月当中特定的日期——斋戒日
1. A designated day of the month—the observance day
古印度的历法属于太阴历，一年分十二个月，月份按月亮绕地球运转的周期推算。推算方法是从每个月圆日的第二天明相出现(aruṇuggamana,黎明)时开始算起，到下一个月圆日的第二天明相出现为至结束23，约三十天（小月为二十九天）的时间为一个月。如此，每个月又可分为两个半月：从月圆日翌日开始到月黑日为“黑月”，从月黑日翌日开始到月圆日为“白月”。其中，月黑日和月圆日两天皆称为“十五日”(paṇṇarasika)。若遇小月，月黑日也可以在十四日。于是，在每半个月中，第八日、第十四和第十五日皆称为“伍波思特日”或“斋戒日”(uposatha-divasa)。斋戒日的日期约相当于中国农历的初八、十四、十五、二十三、廿九和三十日。
The ancient Indian calendar is lunar. It divides the year into twelve months and calculates each month according to the moon’s cycle around the earth. A month begins at dawn (aruṇuggamana) on the day after a full-moon day and ends at dawn on the day after the next full-moon day, lasting about thirty days, or twenty-nine in a short month. Each month is divided into two fortnights: the ‘dark fortnight’ from the day after the full moon to the new moon, and the ‘bright fortnight’ from the day after the new moon to the full moon. The new-moon and full-moon days are both called the ‘fifteenth’ (paṇṇarasika); in a short month the new-moon observance may instead fall on the fourteenth. Thus the eighth, fourteenth, and fifteenth of each fortnight are called Uposatha or observance days (uposatha-divasa), roughly corresponding to the 8th, 14th, 15th, 23rd, 29th, and 30th days of the Chinese lunar month.
2. 在家居士所持守的学处之一 ——八戒
2. One of the observances undertaken by lay devotees—the Eight Precepts
自从佛陀跋葛瓦在世时开始，在家居士就有于每个月的斋日来到塔寺，亲近僧团，听闻佛法，受持八戒的传统。由于八戒多数是在“伍波思特日”受持的，所以称为“具足八支(条)的伍波思特戒法”(aṭṭhaṅga samannāgata uposatha-sīla dhamma)。24
Since the Blessed One’s lifetime, lay devotees have traditionally come to monasteries on the monthly observance days to associate with the Saṅgha, listen to the Dhamma, and undertake the Eight Precepts. Because the Eight Precepts are usually undertaken on an Uposatha day, they are called ‘the Uposatha observance endowed with eight factors’ (aṭṭhaṅga samannāgata uposatha-sīla dhamma).
3. 僧团举行的甘马之一 ——诵戒
One of the kamma held by the monasteries — a recitation
佛陀跋葛瓦规定：比库僧应在每个月的月圆日和月黑日两天举行伍波思特。在这一天，共住同一界内的所有比库僧应齐集界场25，举行伍波思特甘马(uposathakamma)，念诵戒经《比库巴帝摩卡》(pātimokkhuddesa)。26
The Blessed One prescribed that the bhikkhu Saṅgha hold the Uposatha on the full-moon and new-moon days of every month. On those days all bhikkhus living within the same boundary must assemble in the sīmā, perform the Uposatha procedure (uposathakamma), and recite the Bhikkhu Pātimokkha (pātimokkhuddesa).
由于“伍波思特”含有上述多种意思，以“多义不翻”故，一般情况多采用音译，在特定意义时则采用意译。
Because Uposatha carries these several meanings, it is generally transliterated; where a specific meaning is intended, it may be translated accordingly.
伍波思特源于古印度吠陀以来的祭法。佛陀在世时，其他外道团体有于每半个月的八日、十四日、十五日举行集会的习惯。佛陀跋葛瓦接受马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王(Rājā māgadha seniya Bimbisāra)的建议，规定比库僧团应于斋日集会，向信徒们说法，後来又规定于每半月的十五日或十四日齐集诵《巴帝摩卡》。佛教僧团于每半月举行伍波思特诵戒的制度由此而来。
The Uposatha originated in sacrificial observances dating back to the Vedic period of ancient India. During the Buddha’s lifetime, other ascetic groups customarily assembled on the eighth, fourteenth, and fifteenth days of each fortnight. Acting on the suggestion of King Seniya Bimbisāra of Magadha (Rājā māgadha seniya Bimbisāra), the Blessed One prescribed that the bhikkhu Saṅgha assemble on observance days and teach the Dhamma to lay followers. Later he prescribed that the Saṅgha assemble on the fifteenth or fourteenth of each fortnight to recite the Pātimokkha. This is the origin of the Buddhist Saṅgha’s fortnightly Uposatha recitation.
在《律藏zàng·诵戒篇》中说：
The Uposatha Khandhaka of the Vinaya Piṭaka states:
“当时，佛陀跋葛瓦住在王舍城鹫峰山。那个时候，外道游方僧们在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会说法，人们前往该处闻法。他们对外道游方僧获得喜爱、获得信心，外道游方僧们获得了信徒。
‘At that time the Blessed One was staying on Vulture Peak at Rājagaha. At that time wanderers belonging to other sects assembled on the fourteenth, fifteenth, and eighth days of each fortnight and taught the Dhamma. People went to them to hear the teaching, gained affection and confidence in those wanderers, and the wanderers gained followers.
当时，马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王在僻静地独处，心生如此想法:‘现在外道游方僧们在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会说法，人们为闻法前往该处。他们对外道游方僧获得喜爱、获得信心，外道游方僧们获得了信徒。就让诸聖尊们也可在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会。’
Then, while King Seniya Bimbisāra of Magadha was alone in seclusion, this thought arose in him: “These wanderers belonging to other sects assemble on the fourteenth, fifteenth, and eighth days of each fortnight and teach the Dhamma. People go to them to hear the teaching, gain affection and confidence in them, and the wanderers gain followers. What if the venerable ones, too, were to assemble on those days?”
于是，马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王来到跋葛瓦之处。来到之後，顶礼跋葛瓦，坐在一边。坐在一边的马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王对跋葛瓦这样说：
King Seniya Bimbisāra of Magadha then went to the Blessed One, bowed down, and sat to one side. Seated there, he said to the Blessed One:
‘尊者，于此，我在僻静地独处，心生如此想法：现在外道游方僧们在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会说法，人们为闻法前往该处。他们对外道游方僧获得喜爱、获得信心，外道游方僧们获得信徒。就让诸聖尊们也可在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会。萨度！尊者，诸聖尊们也可在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会。’
‘Venerable Sir, while I was alone in seclusion, this thought arose in me: “These wanderers belonging to other sects assemble on the fourteenth, fifteenth, and eighth days of each fortnight and teach the Dhamma. People go to them to hear the teaching, gain affection and confidence in them, and the wanderers gain followers. What if the venerable ones, too, were to assemble on those days?” It would be good, Venerable Sir, if the venerable ones also assembled on the fourteenth, fifteenth, and eighth days of each fortnight.’
于是，跋葛瓦向马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王以法之论开示、劝导、鼓励、令喜悦。当时，马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王受跋葛瓦以法之论开示、劝导、鼓励而喜悦，从座而起，顶礼跋葛瓦，右绕之後离开。
The Blessed One instructed, encouraged, inspired, and gladdened King Seniya Bimbisāra of Magadha with a Dhamma talk. Having been instructed, encouraged, inspired, and gladdened, the king rose from his seat, bowed down to the Blessed One, circumambulated him keeping him on his right, and departed.
于是，跋葛瓦于此因缘、于此机会说法而告诉比库们说：
Then the Blessed One, on this occasion and in connection with this, gave a Dhamma talk and addressed the bhikkhus:
‘诸比库，我允许在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会。’”(V.3.132)
“Bhikkhus, I allow you to assemble on the fourteenth, fifteenth, and eighth days of each fortnight.”’ (V.3.132)
“当时，跋葛瓦在僻静地独处，心生如此想法:‘现在我为比库们所制定的学处，应允许他们诵该巴帝摩卡，他们将以此为伍波思特甘马。’
‘At that time, while the Blessed One was alone in seclusion, this thought arose in him: “I have laid down training rules for the bhikkhus. I should allow them to recite the Pātimokkha and use that recitation as their Uposatha procedure.”
于是，跋葛瓦在傍晚时分禅坐起来後，于此因缘、于此机会说法而告诉比库们说：
Then, after emerging from meditation in the evening, the Blessed One gave a Dhamma talk on this occasion and addressed the bhikkhus:
‘诸比库，于此，我在僻静地独处，心生如此想法：‘我为比库们所制定的学处，应允许他们诵该巴帝摩卡，他们将以此为伍波思特甘马。诸比库，我允许诵巴帝摩卡。’”(V.3.133)
“Bhikkhus, while I was alone in seclusion, this thought arose in me: ‘I have laid down training rules for the bhikkhus. I should allow them to recite the Pātimokkha and use that recitation as their Uposatha procedure.’ Bhikkhus, I allow the recitation of the Pātimokkha.”’ (V.3.133)
“那个时候，比库们以跋葛瓦允许伍波思特日诵巴帝摩卡，在半个月中诵了三次巴帝摩卡——在半月的十四日、十五日及八日。跋葛瓦因此宣告：
‘At that time, because the Blessed One had allowed the Pātimokkha to be recited on Uposatha days, the bhikkhus recited it three times in each fortnight—on the fourteenth, fifteenth, and eighth days. The Blessed One then declared:
‘诸比库，不应半个月诵三次巴帝摩卡。若诵者，犯恶作。诸比库，我允许每半个月一次——在十四日或十五日——诵巴帝摩卡。’”(V.3.136)
“Bhikkhus, the Pātimokkha should not be recited three times in a fortnight. Whoever does so commits an offence of wrong conduct. Bhikkhus, I allow the Pātimokkha to be recited once each fortnight—on the fourteenth or the fifteenth.”’ (V.3.136)

第八节 诵巴帝摩卡的时间和地点Section 8: Time and Place for Reciting the Pātimokkha

既然佛陀跋葛瓦规定比库们于每半个月诵一次巴帝摩卡，即在第十四日或第十五日。具体在十四或十五日，则应视历法而定。
The Blessed One prescribed that bhikkhus recite the Pātimokkha once every fortnight, on either the fourteenth or the fifteenth day. Whether the recitation falls on the fourteenth or fifteenth depends on the calendar.
在律註中说：
It says:
“Cātuddase vā pannarase vā'ti ekassa utuno tatiye ca sattame ca pakkhe dvikkhattuṃ cātuddase, avasese chakkhattuṃ pannarase.”
“在十四日或十五日是指在一个季节中的第三个和第七个半月两次[诵戒]在十四日，其馀六次在十五日。”(V.A.3.136)
“On 14 or 15 days means the third and seventh half-month [recitation] in one season and the sixth in 15 days on 14 days.” (V.A.3.136)
根据古印度的历法，一年分为3个季节：热季(gimhāna)、雨季(vassāna)和凉季(hemanta)，每个季节有4个月，共12个月。如此，一个季节有8个诵戒日，每月有2个，即黑月的十五日（月黑日）和白月的十五日（月圆日）。由于每个季节皆由黑月开始，因此逢单数的诵戒日为月黑日，逢双数的诵戒日为月圆日。在每个季节中，第1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8个半月有15天(paṇṇarasa)，而第3和第7个半月只有14天(catuddasa)。也即是说：在每个季节的第3个和第7个月黑日为“十四日”，其馀的皆为“十五日”。
According to the ancient Indian calendar, the year is divided into three seasons—the hot season (gimhāna), the rainy season (vassāna), and the cool season (hemanta)—each lasting four months, for a total of twelve months. Each season therefore has eight recitation days, two per month: the fifteenth of the dark fortnight, or new-moon day, and the fifteenth of the bright fortnight, or full-moon day. Since each season begins with a dark fortnight, odd-numbered recitation days are new-moon days and even-numbered ones are full-moon days. In each season, the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 5th, 6th, and 8th fortnights have fifteen days (paṇṇarasa), while the 3rd and 7th have only fourteen days (catuddasa). Thus the new-moon days of the 3rd and 7th fortnights are called the ‘fourteenth’; all the others are called the ‘fifteenth’.
所以，僧团安排诵巴帝摩卡的日期，在每个季节的第三次和第七次诵戒在“十四日”，其馀的六次都在“十五日”。这是僧团举行诵戒的日期。27
Thus, the monks set the dates for the reading of Pātimokkha, the third and seventh readings of each season in “fourteen days” and the sixth readings in “thirteen days”. This is the date on which the monks hold the readings.
至于在诵戒日的什么时候举行伍波思特，则可由各个僧团自行决定。现在许多僧团会选择在下午或傍晚举行。
Each Saṅgha may decide at what time on the recitation day to hold the Uposatha. Many communities now choose the afternoon or evening.
由于伍波思特甘马是僧团中比较重要的集会，所以《律藏zàng》中对诵戒的场所有详细的规定：
Since Uposatha is a more important gathering in the monks, all the details of the recitation field in the Collection are as follows:
“当时，比库们这样想：‘跋葛瓦制定：依和合而为一住处。那怎样才是一住处呢？’此事报告跋葛瓦，[跋葛瓦说:]‘诸比库，我允许共结界。诸比库，应如此共结：首先应宣告[界]相——山相、石相、林相、树相、道路相、蚁垤相、河相、水相。”(V.3.138)
“At the time, bhikkhus thought, `The `Zone the Blessed One was set up as a residence.' What would be a place of residence?' The Zone the Blessed One was reported, [The Zone the Blessed One said] `The Zhu the Blessed One, I allow the Zhugwa to be bound together. `The Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu, Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu, Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu, Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Z
也即是说：住在同一区域的所有比库僧众必须集合在一起举行伍波思特甘马。凡举行甘马的地方，必须经由僧团共同认定范围，称为“结界”(sīmā sammuti)。在结界前，先须设立界相(sīmā nimitta)，即范围的标记。律中允许八种界相：以山为界相、以石为界相、以林为界相、以树为界相、以道路为界相、以蚁垤为界相、以河流为界相和以水为界相。现在的做法多数是以石为界相。
In other words, all bhikkhus living in the same area must assemble to perform the Uposatha procedure. A place where a formal act is performed must have its limits collectively designated by the Saṅgha; this is called establishing a boundary (sīmā sammuti). Before the boundary is established, boundary markers (sīmā nimitta) must be set up. The Vinaya permits eight kinds of marker: a mountain, stone, forest, tree, road, anthill, river, or body of water. Stones are most commonly used today.
在律註《疑惑度脱》中提到，界可以分为“已结之界”(baddhasīmā)和“未结之界”(abaddhasīmā)两类。其中，已结之界又可分为划定界、共住界和不离衣界三种；未结之界又可分为村界、七阿邦答勒界和泼水界三种。
The Vinaya commentary Kaṅkhāvitaraṇī says that boundaries are of two kinds: formally established boundaries (baddhasīmā) and boundaries not formally established (abaddhasīmā). Formally established boundaries are further divided into a delimited boundary, a common-residence boundary, and a boundary for non-separation from one’s robes. Boundaries not formally established are divided into a village boundary, a seven-abbhantara boundary, and a water-splash boundary.
在此将通过“以石为界相”来简单地说明结界的程序：先划定“界”范围。根据律制，界的范围最大不得超过三由旬，最小必须能够容纳二十一位比库坐下。划定界的范围後，再找来十六块大小相当的石块（范围较小者，八块也可以），分别放置于界的东南西北方和四个角落，每处各放两块，并把里面的那块作为“石相”(pāsāṇanimitta)。
The procedure for establishing a boundary may be explained briefly using stones as the markers. First, the area of the boundary is defined. Under the Vinaya, it may not extend more than three yojanas, and it must be large enough to seat at least twenty-one bhikkhus. Once the area has been fixed, sixteen stones of similar size are obtained—eight may suffice for a smaller area—and two are placed at each of the four cardinal directions and four corners. The inner stone at each location serves as the stone marker (pāsāṇanimitta).
举行结界甘马前，先安排八位比库或未达上者分别站在界外的石相後边，然後再安排一位比库依次走到每个石相前，问道：“在东方是什么[界]相？”“石，尊者！”“这石是[界]相。”“是的，尊者！”……问完八方的界相後，再走到东方重复问一次，如是使所有界相皆能成为一连结。
Before holding the Gama of the borderline, arrange for eight pictories or unreached to stand behind each other, and then arrange for one by bhikkhus to go to each of the rocks, and ask, “What is the [boundary] in the East?” “The Stone, the Lord!” “The Stone is the [boundary] in the East.” “Yes, the Lord!” After having asked the eight sides of the border, come to the East again and ask again, if all of them are bound together.
问完界相後，所有比库齐集于伸手所及的范围内，宣讲甘马文，共同认定此界为“共住、同一伍波思特界”(samānasaṃvāsa ekuposatha sīmā)。认定了“共住界”之後，再认定“不离衣界”(avippavāsa sīmā)。于是，在这个被划定的范围内所结之界，称为“划定界”(khaṇḍasīmā)。
After the boundary markers have been announced, all the bhikkhus assemble within arm’s reach of one another and recite the formal-act statement, jointly designating the area as a boundary for common residence and one Uposatha (samānasaṃvāsa ekuposatha sīmā). After establishing the common-residence boundary, they establish the boundary for non-separation from one’s robes (avippavāsa sīmā). The boundary formally established within this delimited area is called a delimited boundary (khaṇḍasīmā).
佛陀又规定，如果在一个地方原先曾经如法地结过界，此後在该处所结之界皆为无效。为此，佛陀允许先解除原来所结之界(sīmāsamūhanana)，然後再结新界。如果想在一个新的地方结界，但又不清楚古代是否曾经结过界，为了使日後的甘马皆成为有效，为了保险起见，在结新界之前通常会先解除旧界。由于解界的甘马颇为复杂，于此不作详论。
The Buddha also prescribed that if a valid boundary had previously been established at a place, any later boundary established over it would be invalid. He therefore allowed the former boundary to be abolished (sīmāsamūhanana) before a new one is established. When establishing a boundary at a new site where it is uncertain whether a boundary existed in ancient times, the old boundary is normally abolished first as a precaution so that later formal acts will be valid. The procedure for abolishing a boundary is complex and is not discussed here.
等结界甘马圆满之後，可把石相分别埋于界场的四方四隅，每处埋两块，里面的石块为界相，其外再预留出中间地带，称为“界隔”(sīmantarika)，以避免和其它的“界”相重叠。埋石相时，石块的上半部可以露出地面，形成明显的标记，使人们能清楚地辨认出界相。
After the formal act of establishing the boundary has been completed, the stone markers may be buried at the four cardinal directions and four corners, two at each place. The inner stone is the boundary marker, and a gap called the boundary interval (sīmantarika) is left outside it to prevent overlap with another boundary. The upper half of each stone may remain above ground as a clear marker by which the boundary can be identified.
在《律藏zàng》中又提到“未结之界”的三种情况：
There are three more cases of “unfinished boundaries” mentioned in the Collection:
“诸比库，在无结界或未设置处，若依止村庄或城镇而住，则以该村庄为村界，以城镇为镇界，为该处的共住、同一伍波思特[界]。
“The village shall be used as the boundary of the village, and the town shall be the boundary of the town and the co-occupancy of the village and of the Uposatha [frontier], if the village or town is located on the unsolved or unincorporated border.
诸比库，如果在非村的林野，则周围以七个阿邦答勒为该处的共住、同一伍波思特[界]。
‘Bhikkhus, in forest country outside a village, the area extending seven abbhantaras in every direction is the boundary for common residence and one Uposatha.
诸比库，一切河非界，一切海非界，一切自然湖非界。诸比库，若在河、海或自然湖中，则以中等[身材的]男子向周围泼水处为该处的共住、同一伍波思特[界]。”(V.3.147)
Bhikkhus, no river, sea, or natural lake is itself a boundary. In a river, sea, or natural lake, the area reached when a man of average build throws water in every direction is the boundary for common residence and one Uposatha.’ (V.3.147)
也即是说，如果比库去到边远的地方（例如欧洲、美洲）或没有界场的地方，可以当地政府设置的最小行政区域的范围作为村界(gāmasīmā)或镇界(nigamasīmā)。到了诵戒日，只要在该区域内的所有比库皆齐集并超过四位，则可举行诵戒。
Thus, if bhikkhus travel to a remote region, such as Europe or America, or to a place without a formally established boundary, they may use the smallest local-government administrative area as a village boundary (gāmasīmā) or town boundary (nigamasīmā). On the recitation day, if all bhikkhus in that area assemble and there are at least four, they may hold the recitation.
在森林、郊野等处，则以人站在中央算起，四周各以七个阿邦德勒(sattabbhantarā)的范围为界，称为“七阿邦德勒界”(sattabbhantarasīmā)。这里，一个阿邦德勒等于28肘、56拃手的长度。
In a forest or open countryside, the boundary may be measured from a person standing at the centre, extending seven abbhantaras (sattabbhantarā) in every direction; this is called a seven-abbhantara boundary (sattabbhantarasīmā). Here, one abbhantara equals twenty-eight cubits, or fifty-six handspans.
如果是在河流、海洋或天然湖泊中央，则以一个中等身材的男子向四周尽力泼水，水所洒落的范围称为“泼水界”(udakukkhepasīmā)。
In the middle of a river, sea, or natural lake, a man of average build throws water with full force in every direction. The area reached by the water is called a water-splash boundary (udakukkhepasīmā).
比库僧团可在这三种已结之界和三种未结之界内举行伍波思特甘马，诵巴帝摩卡。
The bhikkhus Monks can hold Uposatha kamma in these three closed and three unsolved bounds to recite Pātimokkha.

第九节 诵巴帝摩卡的基本程序Section 9: Basic Procedure for Reciting the Pātimokkha

念诵巴帝摩卡可以分为略诵和广诵两种。除非是在发生危难的时候可以略诵，在正常情况下僧团皆须广诵。
The recitation of Pātimokkha can be divided into a short reading and a broad reading. Except in times of distress, the monks must read it out in normal circumstances.
在《律藏zàng》中说：
In the book, it says:
“当时，比库们这样想：‘有多少种诵巴帝摩卡?’
"And at that time, more than Cocos thought, "How many of them recited Pātimokkha?"
此事报告跋葛瓦，[跋葛瓦说:]
This is reported to the Blessed One.
‘诸比库，有五种诵巴帝摩卡：
‘Bhikkhus, there are five ways of reciting the Pātimokkha:
诵完序後，可宣告其馀的已听闻；这是第一种诵巴帝摩卡。
And after that it shall be declared as hearing. This is the first of the recitations of Badi Mocca.
诵完序、诵完四巴拉基格後，可宣告其馀的已听闻；这是第二种诵巴帝摩卡。
And after the reading of the four pārājika, it shall be declared that which is heard; this is the second reading of Pātimokkha.
诵完序、诵完四巴拉基格、诵完十三僧始终後，可宣告其馀的已听闻；这是第三种诵巴帝摩卡。
And after the prayer, and after the recitation of the Four pārājika, and the Thirteen Monks, declare what they have heard; and this is the third recitation of Pātimokkha.
诵完序、诵四巴拉基格、诵完十三僧始终、诵完二不定後，可宣告其馀的已听闻；这是第四种诵巴帝摩卡。
After the precitation, after the recitation of the four pārājika, and after the reading of the thirteen monks, after the reading of the thirteen monks, and after the reading of the undeclared, they shall be able to declare what they have heard, and this is the fourth recitation of the Badi Mocca.
第五为广诵。
Fifthly, it's widely read.
诸比库，有这五种诵巴帝摩卡。’
Bhikkhus, these are the five ways of reciting the Pātimokkha.’
那个时候，比库们以跋葛瓦允许略诵巴帝摩卡，在一切时皆略诵巴帝摩卡。此事报告跋葛瓦，[跋葛瓦说:]
At that time, bhikkhus allowed Pātimokkha to be recited to the district of the Blessed One, and at all times to be recited to Pātimokkha.
‘诸比库，不得略诵巴帝摩卡！若略诵者，犯恶作。’
‘bhikkhus, not to recite Pātimokkha! If you recite, do evil.’
那个时候，高沙喇国的一个住处在伍波思特当天发生了蛮族动乱，比库们不能广诵巴帝摩卡。此事报告跋葛瓦，[跋葛瓦说:]
At that time, a house in the Gosa Lama was in the middle of the day of a riot of barbarians in Uposatha, and bhikkhus were unable to read more about Pātimokkha.
‘诸比库，我允许在有危难时略诵巴帝摩卡。’
"Phicoku, I will allow a little recitation of Pātimokkha in times of distress."
那个时候，六众比库在无危难时略诵巴帝摩卡。此事报告跋葛瓦，[跋葛瓦说:]
At that time, the six bhikkhus recited Pātimokkha in the absence of distress.
‘诸比库，不得在无危难时略诵巴帝摩卡！若诵者，犯恶作。诸比库，我允许在有危难时略诵巴帝摩卡。在此的危难是：王难、贼难、火灾、水灾、人难、非人难、猛兽难、蛇难、命难和梵行难。诸比库，我允许在像这些危难[发生]时略诵巴帝摩卡，无危难时则广诵。’”(V.3.150)
‘The Pickus shall not recite Pātimokkha in the absence of distress! If the reciter does evil, I will allow the recitation of Pātimokkha in the event of distress. Here are the distresses: kings, thieves, fire, floods, humans, inhumans, beasts, snakes, fates, and vandals.’ ‘bhikkhus, I will allow the recitation of Pātimokkha in the event of [the occurrence of] these distresses, and when there is no distress, I will read it widely.’” (V.3.150)
到了诵戒日，僧团通常会出通知，提醒僧众们今天是诵戒日，并写明诵戒的时间和地点。
On the day of the recitation, the monks usually give notice to remind the monks that today is the day of the recitation and to state the time and place of the recitation.
诵巴帝摩卡一般可分为四个程序：
The reading of Pātimokkha is usually divided into four procedures:
1.准备工作
Preparatory work
2.宣告事前工作等
2. Declaration of pre-service, etc.
3.正诵
3. Recitation
4.回向
4. Retroactivity
一、准备工作
I. Preparatory work
准备工作又可分为事前任务和事前工作两种。
The preparatory work can be divided into ex ante tasks and ex ante work.
1.事前任务包括打扫卫生、点灯、准备饮用水和洗用水、铺设座位四项。这四项工作必须在僧团齐集界场之前由下座比库或沙马内勒等完成。
1. The pre-mission tasks include cleaning, lighting, preparation of potable water and washing of water, and the laying of four seats. The four tasks must be performed by the next seat, the bhikkhus or sāmaṇera, before the Monk meets the boundary.
2.事前工作包括带来有事比库的意欲（chanda，请假）和清净(pārisuddhi)、计算季节和诵戒的次数、计算参加诵戒比库的人数、教诲比库尼等四项。
Prior work consists of bringing about a situation involving the desire (chanda, leave) and clean (pārisuddhi), the calculation of seasons and the number of readings, the calculation of the number of participants in the reading of the book, and the teaching of bhikkhunīs.
由于跋葛瓦规定犯戒的比库不能参加诵戒，所以，知道自己犯戒的比库在诵戒之前应该到另外一位比库面前坦白并忏悔自己所犯之罪。如果该比库所犯的都是轻罪，则在忏罪之後即回复清净。如果合格的比库28达到四位或以上，则可开始举行伍波思特。
Because the Blessed One prescribed that a bhikkhu with an unconfessed offence may not take part in the recitation, a bhikkhu who knows that he has committed an offence should confess and acknowledge it to another bhikkhu before the recitation. If all his offences are light, purity is restored after the confession. Once there are four or more qualified bhikkhus, the Uposatha may begin.
僧团在举行所有甘马时，处在同一界内的比库皆须齐集一处，并且不得分离于手臂之距离。也即是说，所有参加甘马的比库皆应挨近在一起共坐，两位比库之间的距离不能超过伸手所及的距离。
The monks must be gathered together in the bhikkhus within the same boundary and must not be separated from their arms. That is to say, all the bhikkhus who participate in the Kamma should sit together, and the distance between the two bhikkhus must not exceed the distance reached by the hand.
同时，在此比库聚中，除了比库之外，其他的所有人，包括比库尼、沙马内勒、在家人等皆不得内进，应远离到至少一个伸手所及的距离之外。
At the same time, in this gathering, all but bhikkhus, including bhikkhunīs, sāmaṇera, family members, etc., are not allowed inside and should be kept away from at least one reach.
二、宣告事前工作等
II. Declaration of pre-service, etc.
在开始诵巴帝摩卡之前，僧团长老会选两位比库作为问律者和答律者，以问答的方式告知僧团伍波思特的各项准备工作做得如何、僧团是否达到诵戒的条件等。29 宣告通常使用巴利语，但有些派别只由一位比库诵完宣告的内容30，甚至是用当地的语言来宣告（如缅甸的善法派）。31
Before the Pātimokkha recitation begins, the senior bhikkhu of the Saṅgha appoints two bhikkhus to ask and answer Vinaya questions. Through this exchange they inform the Saṅgha whether the preparations for the Uposatha have been completed and whether the conditions for the recitation are fulfilled. The announcement is normally made in Pāli. In some traditions one bhikkhu recites the whole announcement, and in some, such as the Shwegyin tradition in Myanmar, it is even made in the local language.
三、正诵
III. RELEVANT
当一切准备就绪後，僧团中的长老会指派一位比库诵巴帝摩卡（通常会事先通知）。于是，这位比库以巴利语背诵《比库巴帝摩卡》。
When all preparations are complete, the elders of the Saṅgha appoint a bhikkhu to recite the Pātimokkha (usually informing him in advance). That bhikkhu then recites the Bhikkhu Pātimokkha from memory in Pāli.
完整地背诵巴帝摩卡一般需要35-50分钟的时间，如果诵得稍慢一点，则需要一个小时或以上。在背诵的过程中，如果这位比库有些忘记或诵错的地方，旁边的比库往往会提醒他，使他能流利地、准确无误地背诵下去。
It usually takes 35 to 50 minutes to recite Pātimokkha in its entirety, and it takes an hour or more if it is to be recited a little slower. In the rereading process, if this bhikkhus has forgotten or was wrong, the next one will often remind him that he can recite it in a fluent and accurate manner.
四、回向
IV. RETURN
僧团在诵完巴帝摩卡後通常会做回向，回向的内容由各僧团（或派别）决定。斯里兰卡和缅甸的僧团多数以念诵《护卫经》或散播慈爱等为主，泰国僧团则多数会念些偈颂。做完回向之後，僧团长老通常还会利用僧众集会的因缘给予教诫。
The monks usually turn back when they finish the Pātimokkha, and what they turn back is decided by the monks (or sects). Most monks in Sri Lanka and Myanmar are mainly concerned with the reading of the Guardian or the spread of mercy, while most monks in Thailand recite hymns.
如果同住在一个界内的合格比库达到四位或四位以上，到诵戒日则应举行诵巴帝摩卡，因为四位比库即组成一个僧团(saṅgha)。如果只有两、三位比库共住，属于小众(gaṇa)，不用诵巴帝摩卡，只需作“清净伍波思特”(pārisuddhi-uposatha)。若只有一位比库独住，属于个人(puggala)，到了诵戒日只需作“决意伍波思特”(adhiṭṭhāna-uposatha)即可。具体的做法见本书 p.340-341。(V.3.168)
If four or more qualified bhikkhus live within one boundary, they should recite the Pātimokkha on the recitation day, since four bhikkhus constitute a Saṅgha (saṅgha). If only two or three bhikkhus live together, they form a small group (gaṇa) and do not recite the Pātimokkha; instead, they perform a purity Uposatha (pārisuddhi-uposatha). If one bhikkhu lives alone, he is an individual (puggala) and on the recitation day performs only a determination Uposatha (adhiṭṭhāna-uposatha). The detailed procedures are given on pp. 340–341 of this book. (V.3.168)

Vissajjana: “Āsanena saha pānīyaparibhojanīya- udakaṭṭhapanaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.”
答：座位以及饮用、洗用之水都已经放置好了。
Answer: The seats and the water for drinking and washing have been set out.
Pucchā: “Uposathassa etāni pubbakaraṇan'ti vuccati kiṃ?”
问：什么是“这些称为伍波思特‘事前任务’”？
Question: What is meant by ‘these are called the preliminary tasks of the Uposatha’?”
Vissajjana: “Etāni cattāri vattāni sammajjanakaraṇādīni saṅghasannipātato paṭhamaṃ kattabbattā uposathassa, uposathakammassa pubbakaraṇan'ti vuccati.
答：扫地任务等这四项义务是僧团集合为了伍波思特而首先应当做的，故称为伍波思特甘马的“事前任务”。
Answer: These four duties, beginning with sweeping, must first be performed when the Saṅgha assembles for the Uposatha. They are therefore called the ‘preliminary tasks’ of the Uposatha kamma.
Pubbakaraṇānī'ti akkhātāni.”
“事前任务”已经宣告了。
The preliminary tasks have been announced.

Vissajjana: “Utūnīdha (Utūni'dha) pana sāsane hemanta- gimha-vassānānaṃ vasena tīṇi honti. Ayaṃ hemanta-utu (gimhāna-utu / vassāna-utu).
答：在此教法中有凉季、热季和雨季三季。这时是凉季38。

答：在家人、般哒格等二十一种应被遣出之人必须被遣出于手臂距离之外。他们并不在这里。
Answer: The twenty-one categories of persons who must be excluded, such as householders and paṇḍakas, must be sent beyond arm’s reach. None of them is present here.
Pucchā: “Pattakallan'ti vuccati kiṃ?”

Answer: When the Saṅgha’s Uposatha kamma possesses these four characteristics, it is said that ‘the right time has arrived.’

Kiṃ saṅghassa pubbakiccaṃ? Pārisuddhiṃ āyasmanto ārocetha, pātimokkhaṃ uddisissāmi, taṃ sabbeva santā sādhukaṃ suṇoma manasi karoma.
什么是僧团的事前工作？请具寿们告知清净，我将诵巴帝摩卡。请所有在场者对此好好地倾听、作意！

Yassa siyā āpatti, so āvikareyya, asantiyā āpattiyā tuṇhī bhavitabbaṃ, tuṇhībhāvena kho panāyasmante “parisuddhā”ti vedissāmi. Yathā kho pana paccekapuṭṭhassa veyyākaraṇaṃ hoti, evamevaṃ evarūpāya parisāya yāvatatiyaṃ anusāvitaṃ hoti. Yo pana bhikkhu yāvatatiyaṃ anusāviyamāne saramāno santiṃ āpattiṃ nāvikareyya, sampajānamusāvādassa hoti. Sampajānamusāvādo kho panāyasmanto antarāyiko dhammo vutto bhagavatā, tasmā saramānena bhikkhunā āpannena visuddhāpekkhena santī āpatti āvikātabbā, āvikatā hissa phāsu hoti.
凡是有罪者，他要坦白；没有罪者应保持沉默。以沉默故，我将知道具寿们是清净的。正如对单一的问题有所回答，同样地，在如此之众中有乃至第三次的宣告。若比库在乃至第三次的宣告时，记得有罪却不坦白，对他则是故意虚妄语。诸具寿，跋葛瓦说过故意虚妄语是障碍法。因此，记得曾犯戒而希望清净的比库有罪应坦白，因坦白了对他才能安乐。
Anyone who has committed an offense should reveal it. If you haven’t committed any offense, you should remain silent. If you are silent, I will regard you as pure. Just as one responds when asked individually, so too, an announcement is made three times in this kind of gathering. If a monk remembers an offense while the announcement is being made up to the third time, but doesn’t reveal it, he is lying in full awareness. Lying in full awareness is called an obstacle by the Buddha. A monk who remembers an offense and is seeking purification should therefore reveal it. When it’s revealed, he will be at ease.SC

Pārājikuddeso
巴拉基格诵
Recitation of the Rules on Expulsion
Tatrime cattāro pārājikā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
于此，诵出此四巴拉基格法来。
These four rules on expulsion come up for recitation.SC
1. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno sikkhaṃ apaccakkhāya68 dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ patiseveyya69, antamaso tiracchānagatāyapi, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
1.若比库得到比库们之学和生活规则，未捨弃学，没表明羸弱而从事淫欲法者，乃至和畜生，也是巴拉基格，不共住。
If a monk, after taking on the monks’ training and way of life, without first renouncing the training and revealing his weakness, has sexual intercourse, even with a female animal, he is expelled and excluded from the community.SC
2. Yo pana bhikkhu gāmā vā araññā vā adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyeyya, yathārūpe adinnādāne rājāno coraṃ gahetvā haneyyuṃ vā bandheyyuṃ vā pabbājeyyuṃ vā corosi bālosi mūḷhosi thenosīti, tathārūpaṃ bhikkhu adinnaṃ ādiyamāno ayampi pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
2.若比库从村落或林野，以偷盗之心不与而取，因如何般不与取，诸王抓住盗贼後会打杀、捆缚或驱逐:“你是小偷、愚者、痴者、盗贼。”如此般不与而取的这比库也是巴拉基格，不共住。
If a monk, intending to steal, takes from an inhabited area or from the wilderness what has not been given to him— the sort of stealing for which kings, having caught a thief, would beat, imprison, or banish him, saying, ‘You’re a bandit, you’re a fool, you’ve gone astray, you’re a thief’— he too is expelled and excluded from the community.SC
3. Yo pana bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, satthahārakaṃ vāssa pariyeseyya, maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya “ambho purisa kiṃ tuyhiminā pāpakena dujjīvitena, matante70 jīvitā seyyo”ti, iti cittamano cittasaṅkappo anekapariyāyena maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya, ayampi pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
3.若比库故意夺取人命，或为其寻找可取[命]的杀具，或赞叹死亡的美好，或劝勉死:“喂，男子！你为何以此悲惨地痛苦活着？你死了比活着更好!”如是心意、心思惟，用各种方法赞叹死亡的美好，或劝勉死，这也是巴拉基格，不共住。
If a monk intentionally kills a human being or seeks an instrument of death for them or praises death or incites someone to die, saying, ‘My friend, what’s the point of this miserable and difficult life? Death is better for you than life!’— thinking and intending thus, if he praises death in many ways or incites someone to die— he too is expelled and excluded from the community.SC
4. Yo pana bhikkhu anabhijānaṃ uttarimanussa- dhammaṃ attūpanāyikaṃ71 alamariyañāṇadassanaṃ
4.若比库声称关于自己未证知的、能为聖智见
If a monk falsely claims for himself a superhuman quality, a knowledge and vision worthy of the noble ones, saying, ‘This I know, this I see,’SC

的上人法:“我如是知，我如是见。”从那之後的时间，[无论]被检问或没被检问，已犯罪却希望清净而如此说：“诸贤友，不知如此而言‘我知’，不见[而言]‘我见’，说了空无的虚妄语。”除了增上慢外，这也是巴拉基格，不共住。

Saṅghādisesuddeso
桑喀地谢思诵
Recitation of the Rules on Suspension
Ime kho panāyasmanto terasa saṅghādisesā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
诸具寿，诵出此十三桑喀地谢思法来。
Venerables, these thirteen rules on suspension come up for recitation.SC
1. Sañcetanikā sukkavisaṭṭhi74 aññatra supinantā saṅghādiseso.
1.故意出精，除了梦中外，桑喀地谢思。
Intentional emission of semen, except while dreaming, is an offense entailing suspension.SC
2. Yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmena saddhiṃ kāyasaṃsaggaṃ samāpajjeyya hatthagāhaṃ vā veṇigāhaṃ75 vā aññatarassa vā aññatarassa vā aṅgassa parāmasanaṃ, saṅghādiseso.
2.若比库以贪染、变易之心和女人发生身体相接触，或捉手，或捉发，或摩触任何部分者，桑喀地谢思。
If a monk, overcome by lust and with a distorted mind, makes physical contact with a woman—holding her hand or hair, or touching any part of her body—he commits an offense entailing suspension.SC
3. Yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāseyya yathā taṃ yuvā yuvatiṃ methūnupasaṃhitāhi76, saṅghādiseso.
3.若比库以贪染、变易之心对女人说粗俗语，犹如少男对少女[说]和淫欲相关者一样，桑喀地谢思。
If a monk, overcome by lust and with a distorted mind, speaks indecent words to a woman, as a young man might to a young woman and referring to sexual intercourse, he commits an offense entailing suspension.SC
4. Yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmassa santike attakāmapāricariyāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyya “etadaggaṃ bhagini pāricariyānaṃ yā mādisaṃ sīlavantaṃ kalyāṇadhammaṃ brahmacāriṃ etena dhammena paricareyyā”ti methūnupasaṃhitena77, saṅghādiseso.
4.若比库以贪染、变易之心在女人面前，赞叹以欲侍奉自己:“姐妹，若用此法来侍奉像我这样的持戒者、善法者、梵行者，这是诸侍奉中最高的。”和淫欲相关者，桑喀地谢思。
If a monk, overcome by lust and with a distorted mind, encourages a woman to satisfy his own desires, saying, ‘Sister, she provides the highest service who in this way satisfies one like me, who is virtuous, celibate, and of good character,’ and if it is a reference to sexual intercourse, he commits an offense entailing suspension.SC
5. Yo pana bhikkhu sañcarittaṃ samāpajjeyya itthiyā vā purisamatiṃ purisassa vā itthimatiṃ78, jāyattane vā jārattane vā, antamaso taṅkhaṇikāya'pi79, saṅghādiseso.
5.若比库从事做媒，[传达]男子情意给女子，或女子情意给男子，而成为妻子或情人，乃至短暂关系，也桑喀地谢思。
If a monk acts as a matchmaker, conveying a man’s intention to a woman or a woman’s intention to a man, for marriage or for an affair, even if just a brief one, he commits an offense entailing suspension.SC
Source pages 98–99 / 原书第 98–99 页
Pāli · p. 98
中文与 English · p. 99
6. Saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ attuddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatridaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ sattantarā, bhikkhū abhinetabbā vatthudesanāya, tehi bhikkhūhi vatthu desetabbaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ. Sārambhe ce bhikkhu vatthusmiṃ aparikkamane saññācikāya kuṭiṃ kāreyya, bhikkhū vā anabhineyya vatthudesanāya, pamāṇaṃ vā atikkāmeyya, saṅghādiseso.
6.比库指定为自己建造自行乞求的无[施]主孤邸时，应适量而造。对此其量是：长为善至张手的十二张手，内部宽为七张。应带领比库们指示地点，应由那些比库指示无侵害、有环绕空间的地点。假如比库在有侵害、无环绕空间的地点建造自行乞求的孤邸，或未带领比库们指示地点，或超过量者，桑喀地谢思。
When a monk, by means of begging, builds a hut without a sponsoring owner and intended for himself, it is to be no more than twelve standard handspans long and seven wide inside. He must have monks approve a site where no harm will be done and which has space on all sides. If a monk, by means of begging, builds a hut on a site where harm will be done and which lacks space on all sides, or he does not have monks approve the site, or he exceeds the right size, he commits an offense entailing suspension.SC
7. Mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena sassāmikaṃ attuddesaṃ bhikkhū abhinetabbā vatthudesanāya, tehi bhikkhūhi vatthu desetabbaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ. Sārambhe ce bhikkhu vatthusmiṃ aparikkamane mahallakaṃ vihāraṃ kāreyya, bhikkhū vā anabhineyya vatthudesanāya, saṅghādiseso.
7.比库在为自己建造有[施]主的大住所时，应带领比库们指示地点，应由那些比库指示无侵害、有环绕空间的地点。假如比库在有侵害、无环绕空间的地点建造大住所，或未带领比库们指示地点者，桑喀地谢思。
When a monk builds a large dwelling with a sponsoring owner and intended for himself, he must have monks approve a site where no harm will be done and which has space on all sides. If a monk builds a large dwelling on a site where harm will be done and which lacks space on all sides, or he does not have monks approve the site, he commits an offense entailing suspension.SC
8. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya “appeva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan”ti. tato aparena samayena samanuggāhīyamāno vā asamanuggāhīyamāno vā amūlakañceva taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti, bhikkhu ca dosaṃ patiṭṭhāti, saṅghādiseso.
8.若比库恶意、瞋恨、不满，用无根据的巴拉基格法诽谤比库:“或许能使他从梵行退堕。”从那之後的时间，[无论]被检问或没被检问，那案情只是毫无根据的，且比库基于瞋恨，桑喀地谢思。
If a monk who is angry and displeased groundlessly charges a monk with an offense entailing expulsion, aiming to make him leave the monastic life, and then after some time, whether he is questioned or not, it is clear that the legal issue is groundless, and he admits to his ill will, he commits an offense entailing suspension.SC
9. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto aññabhāgiyassa adhikaraṇassa kiñcidesaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāya pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya “appeva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan”ti. tato aparena samayena samanuggāhīyamāno vā asamanuggāhīyamāno vā aññabhāgiyañceva taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti kocideso lesamatto upādinno, bhikkhu ca dosaṃ patiṭṭhāti, saṅghādiseso.
9.若比库恶意、瞋恨、不满，取其它事情的某些部分类似之处，用巴拉基格法诽谤比库:“或许能使他从此梵行退堕。”从那之後的时间，[无论]被检问或没被检问，那案情只是取了其它部分的某些类似之处，且比库基于瞋恨，桑喀地谢思。
If a monk who is angry and displeased, uses an unrelated legal issue as a pretext to charge a monk with an offense entailing expulsion, aiming to make him leave the monastic life, and then after some time, whether he is questioned or not, it is clear that the legal issue is unrelated and was used as a pretext, and he admits to his ill will, he commits an offense entailing suspension.SC
Source pages 100–101 / 原书第 100–101 页
Pāli · p. 100
中文与 English · p. 101
10. Yo pana bhikkhu samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkameyya, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha tiṭṭheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evamassa vacanīyo “mā āyasmā80 samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkami, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha aṭṭhāsi, sametāyasmā saṅghena, samaggo hi saṅgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharatī”ti, evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya, yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce paṭinissajjeyya, saṅghādiseso.
10.若比库致力于和合僧团的分裂，或受持、坚持导致分裂之事而住。比库们要如此劝告那个比库:“请具寿不要致力于和合僧团的分裂，或受持、坚持导致分裂之事而住。请具寿与僧团和合，和合的僧团确实欢喜、无争、同一诵[戒]而安乐住！”那个比库被比库们如此劝告时，仍然那样坚持，比库们为了使那比库捨弃它，应乃至第三次劝谏。在乃至第三次劝谏时如果捨弃了它，这样很好。假如不捨弃，桑喀地谢思。
If a monk pursues schism in a united Sangha or persists in taking up a legal issue conducive to schism, the monks should correct him like this: ‘Venerable, don’t pursue schism in the united Sangha or persist in taking up a legal issue conducive to schism. Stay with the Sangha, for a united Sangha—in concord, in harmony, having a joint recitation—is at ease.’ If that monk continues as before, the monks should press him up to three times to make him stop. If he then stops, all is well. If he does not stop, he commits an offense entailing suspension.SC
11. Tasseva kho pana bhikkhussa bhikkhū honti anuvattakā vaggavādakā eko vā dve vā tayo vā, te evaṃ vadeyyuṃ “mā āyasmanto etaṃ bhikkhuṃ kiñci avacuttha, dhammavādī ceso bhikkhu, vinayavādī ceso bhikkhu, amhākañceso bhikkhu chandañca ruciñca ādāya voharati, jānāti no bhāsati, amhākampetaṃ khamatī”ti, te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi evamassu vacanīyā “mā āyasmanto evaṃ avacuttha, na ceso bhikkhu dhammavādī, na ceso bhikkhu vinayavādī, mā āyasmantānampi saṅghabhedo ruccittha, sametāyasmantānaṃ saṅghena, samaggo hi saṅgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharatī”ti evañca te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi vuccamānā tatheva paggaṇheyyuṃ, te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbā tassa paṭinissaggāya, yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamānā taṃ paṭinissajjeyyuṃ, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce paṭinissajjeyyuṃ, saṅghādiseso.
11.就那个比库的追随者、别众说者有一个、两个或三个比库，若他们如此说:“诸具寿，请不要说那位比库的任何事。那位比库是依法说者，那位比库是依律说者，那位比库取我们所欲和所喜乐的而说，知道我们而说，那是我们认可的。”比库们要如此劝告那些比库:“请具寿们不要如此说，那个比库不是依法说者，那个比库也不是依律说者。诸具寿，不要喜欢分裂僧团。诸具寿，请与僧团和合，和合的僧团确实是欢喜、无争、同一诵[戒]、安乐而住的！”当比库们在如此劝告那些比库时，他们仍然坚持，比库们为了使那些比库捨弃它，应乃至第三次劝谏。在乃至第三次劝谏时如果捨弃了它，这样很好。假如不捨弃，桑喀地谢思。
That monk may have one, two, or three monks who side with him and support him, and they may say, ‘Venerables, don’t correct this monk. He speaks in accordance with the Teaching and the training. And he speaks with our consent and approval. He knows about us and speaks for us, and we approve of this.’ The monks should correct those monks like this: ‘No, venerables, this monk speaks contrary to the Teaching and the training. And don’t consent to schism in the Sangha. Stay with the Sangha, for a united Sangha—in concord, in harmony, having a joint recitation—is at ease.’ If those monks continue as before, the monks should press them up to three times to make them stop. If they then stop, all is well. If they do not stop, they commit an offense entailing suspension.SC

If a monk is difficult to correct, and he makes himself incorrigible when legitimately corrected by the monks concerning the training rules that are recited, saying, ‘Venerables, don’t say anything to me, either good or bad, and I won’t say anything to you, either good or bad. 诸具寿，已诵出首犯即犯的九条、乃至第三次[劝谏才犯]的四条之十三桑喀地谢思法。若比库犯了其中任何一条後，明知而隐瞒多少天，[即使]该比库不愿意，[也]应别住多少天。住了别住的比库还应再履行六夜的敬悦比库。行了敬悦的比库，哪里有二十众的比库僧团，该比库即应在那里出罪。二十众的比库僧团假如缺少哪怕一位给该比库出罪，该比库也不能出罪，而且那些比库应受指责。这于此是随适的。
Venerables, the thirteen rules on suspension have been recited, nine being immediate offenses, four after the third announcement. If a monk commits any one of them, he is to undergo probation for the same number of days as he knowingly concealed that offense. When this is completed, he must undertake the trial period for a further six days. When this is completed, he is to be rehabilitated wherever there is a sangha of at least twenty monks. If that monk is rehabilitated by a sangha of even one less than twenty, that monk is not rehabilitated and those monks are blameworthy. This is the proper procedure.SC

Aniyatuddeso
不定诵
Recitation of the Undetermined Rules
Ime kho panāyasmanto dve aniyatā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
诸具寿，诵出此二不定法来。
Venerables, these two undetermined rules come up for recitation.SC
1. Yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho paṭicchanne āsane alaṃkammaniye nisajjaṃ kappeyya, tamenaṃ saddheyyavacasā upāsikā disvā tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena vadeyya pārājikena vā saṅghādisesena vā pācittiyena vā, nisajjaṃ bhikkhu paṭijānamāno tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena kāretabbo pārājikena vā saṅghādisesena vā pācittiyena vā, yena vā sā saddheyyavacasā upāsikā vadeyya, tena so bhikkhu kāretabbo, ayaṃ dhammo aniyato.
1.若比库单独和一女人在秘密隐蔽适合行[淫]的座位共坐，有说话可信的近事女看见他後，以巴拉基格、桑喀地谢思或巴吉帝亚三法中的其中一种指控。承认坐的比库应依巴拉基格、桑喀地谢思或巴吉帝亚三法的其中一种作惩治，或依那位说话可信的近事女所说的那样来惩治该比库。这是不定法。
If a monk sits down in private alone with a woman on a concealed seat suitable for the deed, and a trustworthy female lay follower sees him and accuses him of an offense entailing expulsion, an offense entailing suspension, or an offense entailing confession, then, if he admits to the sitting, he is to be dealt with according to one of these three or according to what that trustworthy female lay follower has said. This rule is undetermined.SC
2. Na heva kho pana paṭicchannaṃ āsanaṃ hoti nālaṃkammaniyaṃ, alañca kho hoti mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāsituṃ, yo pana bhikkhu tathārūpe āsane mātugāmena saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho nisajjaṃ kappeyya, tamenaṃ saddheyyavacasā upāsikā disvā dvinnaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena vadeyya saṅghādisesena vā pācittiyena vā, nisajjaṃ bhikkhu paṭijānamāno dvinnaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena kāretabbo saṅghādisesena vā pācittiyena vā, yena vā sā saddheyyavacasā upāsikā vadeyya, tena so bhikkhu kāretabbo, ayampi dhammo aniyato.
2.有并非隐蔽、不适合行[淫]但是却适合对女人说粗俗语的座位。若比库在这样的座位单独和一女人秘密共坐，有说话可信的近事女看见他後，以桑喀地谢思或巴吉帝亚二法的其中一种指控。承认坐的比库应依桑喀地谢思或巴吉帝亚二法的其中一种作惩治，或依那位说话可信的近事女所说的那样来惩治该比库。这也是不定法。
Although a seat is not concealed, nor suitable for the deed, it may be suitable for speaking indecently to a woman. If a monk sits down on such a seat in private alone with a woman, and a trustworthy female lay follower sees him and accuses him of an offense entailing suspension or an offense entailing confession, then, if he admits to the sitting, he is to be dealt with according to one of these two or according to what that trustworthy female lay follower has said. This rule too is undetermined.SC

Nissaggiyapācittiyā
尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚
Rules on Relinquishment and Confession
Ime kho panāyasmanto tiṃsa nissaggiyā pācittiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
诸具寿，诵出此三十尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚法来。
Venerables, these thirty rules on relinquishment and confession come up for recitation.SC
1. Niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kaṭhine88 dasāhaparamaṃ atirekacīvaraṃ dhāretabbaṃ, taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
1.比库衣已完成、咖提那已捨出时，多馀的衣最多可持有十天。超过此者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
When his robe is finished and the robe season has ended, a monk should keep an extra robe for ten days at the most. If he keeps it longer than that, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
2. Niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kaṭhine ekarattampi ce bhikkhu ticīvarena vippavaseyya, aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā89 nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
2.比库之衣已完成、咖提那已捨出时，假如比库离开三衣即使一夜，除了比库共许外，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
When his robe is finished and the robe season has ended, if a monk stays apart from his three robes even for a single day, except if the monks have agreed, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
3. Niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kaṭhine bhikkhuno paneva akālacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ, paṭiggahetvā khippameva kāretabbaṃ, no cassa pāripūri, māsaparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā taṃ cīvaraṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ ūnassa pāripūriyā satiyā paccāsāya. Tato ce uttariṃ nikkhipeyya satiyāpi paccāsāya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
3.比库之衣已完成、咖提那已捨出时，比库仍得到非时衣，想要的比库可以接受，接受後应尽快地做。如果不足，存有为补足不足的期望时，那位比库可存放该衣最多一个月。假如存放超过此者，即使存有期望，也尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
When his robe is finished and the robe season has ended, if out-of-season robe-cloth is offered to a monk, he may receive it if he wishes. If he receives it, he should quickly make a robe. If there is not enough cloth, but he is expecting more, he should keep it at most one month to make up the lack. If he keeps it longer than that, then even if he expects more cloth, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
4. Yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā purāṇacīvaraṃ dhovāpeyya vā rajāpeyya vā ākoṭāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
4.若比库使非亲戚的比库尼洗、染或打旧衣者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If a monk has an unrelated nun wash, dye, or beat a used robe, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
5. Yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyya aññatra pārivaṭṭakā90, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
5.若比库从非亲戚的比库尼手中接受衣，除了交换外，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If a monk receives a robe directly from an unrelated nun, except in exchange, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
Source pages 114–115 / 原书第 114–115 页
Pāli · p. 114
中文与 English · p. 115
6. Yo pana bhikkhu aññātakaṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatāniṃ vā cīvaraṃ viññāpeyya aññatra samayā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. Tatthāyaṃ samayo, acchinnacīvaro vā hoti bhikkhu, naṭṭhacīvaro vā, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
6.若比库向非亲戚的家主或女家主乞衣，除了适时外，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。这是于此的适时：比库被夺衣或丢失衣。这是于此的适时。
If a monk asks an unrelated male or female householder for a robe, except on an appropriate occasion, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession. These are the appropriate occasions: his robes are stolen or his robes are lost.SC
7. Tañce aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā bahūhi cīvarehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, santaruttaraparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tato cīvaraṃ sāditabbaṃ. Tato ce uttariṃ sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
7.如果非亲戚的家主或女家主以许多衣邀请他拿取，那位比库可从其中最多接受上、下衣。假如接受超过此者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If an unrelated male or female householder invites that monk to take many robes, he should accept at most one sarong and one upper robe. If he accepts more than that, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
8. Bhikkhuṃ paneva uddissa aññātakassa gahapatissa vā gahapatāniyā vā cīvaracetāpannaṃ91 upakkhaṭaṃ hoti “iminā cīvaracetāpannena cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarena acchādessāmī”ti, tatra ce so bhikkhu pubbe appavārito upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjeyya “sādhu vata maṃ āyasmā iminā cīvaracetāpannena evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā acchādehī”ti kalyāṇakamyataṃ upādāya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
8.非亲戚的家主或女家主指定给比库准备衣资:“我将以此衣资交换衣後，用衣给某某比库披着。”假如那位比库事先未受邀请即前往那里对衣作指示:“具寿，唯请以此衣资交换这样或那样的衣给我披着。”出于欲求好者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If a male or female householder has set aside a robe fund for an unrelated monk, thinking, ‘With this robe fund I will buy robe-cloth and give it to monk so-and-so;’ and if that monk, without first being invited, goes to them and specifies the kind of robe-cloth he wants, saying, ‘Please use this robe fund to buy such-and-such robe-cloth and then give it to me,’ and he does so because he wants something fine, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
9. Bhikkhuṃ paneva uddissa ubhinnaṃ aññātakānaṃ gahapatīnaṃ vā gahapatānīnaṃ vā paccekacīvara- cetāpannāni upakkhaṭāni honti “imehi mayaṃ paccekacīvaracetāpannehi paccekacīvarāni cetāpetvā itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarehi acchādessāmā”ti, tatra ce so bhikkhu pubbe appavārito upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjeyya “sādhu vata maṃ āyasmanto imehi paccekacīvaracetāpannehi evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā acchādetha ubhova santā ekenā”ti kalyāṇakamyataṃ upādāya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
9.两位非亲戚的家主或女家主指定给比库准备各别的衣资:“我们将用这些各别的衣资交换各别的衣後，送衣给某某比库披着。”假如那位比库事先未受到邀请即前往那里对衣作指示:“诸具寿，唯请以这些各别的衣资合二为一，交换这样或那样的衣给我披着。”出于欲求好者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If two male or female householders have set aside separate robe funds for an unrelated monk, thinking, ‘With these separate robe funds we’ll buy separate robe-cloths and give them to monk so-and-so;’ and if that monk, without first being invited, goes to them and specifies the kind of robe-cloth he wants, saying, ‘Please put these separate robe funds together to buy such-and-such robe-cloth and then give it to me,’ and he does so because he wants something fine, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC

10. Bhikkhuṃ paneva uddissa rājā vā rājabhoggo vā brāhmaṇo vā gahapatiko vā dūtena cīvaracetāpannaṃ pahiṇeyya “iminā cīvaracetāpannena cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarena acchādehī”ti. So ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya “idaṃ kho, bhante, āyasmantaṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpannaṃ ābhataṃ, paṭigaṇhātu92 āyasmā cīvaracetāpannan”ti. Tena bhikkhunā so dūto evamassa vacanīyo “na kho mayaṃ, āvuso, cīvaracetāpannaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma, cīvarañca kho mayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma kālena kappiyan”ti.
10.若王、王臣、婆罗门或家主派使者指定给比库送衣资:“请你以此衣资交换衣後，用衣给某某比库披着!”如果该使者前往那位比库处後如此说:“尊者，这是指定为具寿带来的衣资，请具寿接受衣资吧!”该比库宜对那位使者如此说:“贤友，我们不接受衣资，我们在适时接受许可之衣。”
If a king, a king’s employee, a brahmin, or a householder sends a robe fund for a monk by messenger, saying, ‘Buy robe-cloth with this robe fund and give it to monk so-and-so,’ and the messenger goes to that monk and says, ‘Venerable, I have brought a robe fund for you. Please receive it,’ then that monk should reply, ‘We don’t receive robe funds, but we do receive allowable robe-cloth at the right time.’SC
So ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadeyya “atthi panāyasmato koci veyyāvaccakaro”ti. Cīvaratthikena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro niddisitabbo ārāmiko vā upāsako vā “eso kho, āvuso, bhikkhūnaṃ veyyāvaccakaro”ti. So ce dūto taṃ veyyāvaccakaraṃ saññāpetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya “yaṃ kho, bhante, āyasmā veyyāvaccakaraṃ niddisi, saññatto so mayā, upasaṅkamatu āyasmā kālena, cīvarena taṃ acchādessatī”ti.
如果该使者对那位比库如此说:“有哪位是具寿的服务者吗?”诸比库，需要衣的比库可指出园民或近事男为服务者:“贤友，这位就是比库们的服务者。”如果该使者交代那位服务者後，前往那位比库处如此说:“尊者，具寿所指出的服务者我已经交代他了，请具寿在适时前往，他将送衣给您披着。”
If that messenger says, ‘Is there anyone who provides services for you?’ the monk, if he needs robe-cloth, should point out a monastery worker or a lay follower and say, ‘They provide services for the monks.’ If the messenger instructs that service provider and then returns to the monk and says, ‘Venerable, I have instructed the service provider you pointed out. Please go to them at the right time and they’ll give you robe-cloth,’SC
Cīvaratthikena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro upasaṅkamitvā dvattikkhattuṃ93 codetabbo sāretabbo “attho me, āvuso, cīvarenā”ti, dvattikkhattuṃ codayamāno sārayamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce abhinipphādeyya, catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ chakkhattuparamaṃ tuṇhībhūtena uddissa ṭhātabbaṃ, catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ chakkhattu- paramaṃ tuṇhībhūto uddissa tiṭṭhamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ
诸比库，需要衣的比库前往服务者之处後，可催促、提醒两、三次:“贤友，我需要衣。”若催促、提醒两、三次时获得该衣，这样很好。假如没有获得，可四次、五次，最多六次为此而静默地站着。若在四次、五次，最多六次为此而静默地站着时获
then, if that monk needs robe-cloth, he should go to that service provider and prompt them and remind them two or three times, saying, ‘I need robe-cloth.’ If he then gets robe-cloth, all is well. If he does not get it, he should stand in silence for it at most six times. If he then gets robe-cloth, all is well.SC

abhinipphādeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ,94 tato ce uttariṃ vāyamamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
得该衣，这样很好。假如[没有获得，]由此更作努力时才获得该衣者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If he makes any further effort and then gets robe-cloth, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
No ce abhinipphādeyya, yatassa cīvaracetāpannaṃ ābhataṃ, tattha sāmaṃ vā gantabbaṃ, dūto vā pāhetabbo “yaṃ kho tumhe āyasmanto bhikkhuṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpannaṃ pahiṇittha, na taṃ tassa95 bhikkhuno kiñci atthaṃ anubhoti, yuñjantāyasmanto sakaṃ, mā vo sakaṃ vinassā”ti96, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
如果没有获得，则须自己去或派遣使者到为他送来衣资之处:“诸具寿，你们曾指定给比库所送去的衣资，它不曾达成那比库的任何利益。诸具寿，努力要回自己的，不要失去你们自己的!”这于此是随适的。
If he does not get robe-cloth, he should go to the owners of that robe fund, or send a message, saying, ‘That monk hasn’t received any benefit from the robe fund you sent for him. Please recover what’s yours, or it might perish.’ This is the proper procedure.SC

第一 衣品
The first subchapter on the robe season is finished.SC
11. Yo pana bhikkhu kosiyamissakaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
11.若比库做混有蚕丝的敷具者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If a monk has a blanket made that contains silk, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
12. Yo pana bhikkhu suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
12.若比库做纯黑色的羊毛敷具者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If a monk has a blanket made entirely of black wool, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
13. Navaṃ pana bhikkhunā santhataṃ kārayamānena dve bhāgā suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ ādātabbā, tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ, catutthaṃ gocariyānaṃ. Anādā ce bhikkhu dve bhāge suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ, tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ, catutthaṃ gocariyānaṃ, navaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
13.比库在做新敷具时，应取两部分纯黑色的羊毛，第三为白色，第四为褐色。假如比库不取两部分纯黑色的羊毛，第三为白色，第四为褐色而做新敷具者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If a monk is having a new blanket made, he should use two parts of entirely black wool, a third part of white, and a fourth part of brown. If he has a new blanket made without using two parts of entirely black wool, a third part of white, and a fourth part of brown, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
14. Navaṃ pana bhikkhunā santhataṃ kārāpetvā chabbassāni dhāretabbaṃ, orena ce channaṃ vassānaṃ taṃ santhataṃ vissajjetvā vā avissajjetvā vā aññaṃ navaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
14.比库做新敷具後应持用六年。在六年之内无论捨弃或未捨该敷具，假如再做其它新敷具者，除了比库共许外，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If a monk has had a new blanket made, he should keep it for six years. Whether that blanket has been given away or not, if he has another new blanket made in less than six years, except if the monks have agreed, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC

15. Nisīdanasanthataṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena purāṇasanthatassa sāmantā sugatavidatthi ādātabbā dubbaṇṇakaraṇāya. Anādā ce bhikkhu purāṇasanthatassa sāmantā sugatavidatthiṃ, navaṃ nisīdanasanthataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
15.比库在做坐垫时，应从旧敷具的周边取善至的一张手以作坏色。假如比库不从旧敷具的周边取善至的一张手而做新坐垫者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If a monk is having a sitting blanket made, he must incorporate a piece of one standard handspan from the border of an old blanket in order to make it ugly. If he has a new sitting blanket made without incorporating a piece of one standard handspan from the border of an old blanket, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
16. Bhikkhuno paneva addhānamaggappaṭipannassa eḷakalomāni uppajjeyyuṃ, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbāni, paṭiggahetvā tiyojanaparamaṃ sahatthā haritabbāni97 asante hārake. Tato ce uttariṃ hareyya, asantepi hārake, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
16.在旅行途中的比库若获得羊毛，想要的比库可以接受。接受後，在没有人拿时，最多可亲手拿三由旬。假如拿超过此者，即使没有人拿，也尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If wool is given to a monk who is traveling, he may receive it if he wishes. If he receives it and there is no one else to carry it, he may carry it himself for at most 40 kilometers. If he carries it further than that, even if there is no one else to carry it, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
17. Yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā eḷakalomāni dhovāpeyya vā rajāpeyya vā vijaṭāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
17.若比库使非亲戚的比库尼洗、染或梳羊毛者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If a monk has an unrelated nun wash, dye, or comb wool, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
18. Yo pana bhikkhu jātarūparajataṃ uggaṇheyya vā uggaṇhāpeyya vā upanikkhittaṃ vā sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
18.若比库捉取金银，或令捉取，或同意放在近处者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If a monk takes, has someone else take, or consents to gold, silver, or money being deposited for him, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
19. Yo pana bhikkhu nānappakārakaṃ rūpiyasaṃvohāraṃ samāpajjeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
19.若比库从事各种金钱交易者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If a monk engages in various kinds of trades involving money, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
20. Yo pana bhikkhu nānappakārakaṃ kayavikkayaṃ samāpajjeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
20.若比库从事各种买卖者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If a monk engages in various kinds of barter, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
Kosiyavaggo dutiyo.

The second subchapter on silk is finished.SC
21. Dasāhaparamaṃ atirekapatto dhāretabbo, taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
21.多馀的钵最多可持有十天。超过此者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
A monk should keep an extra almsbowl for ten days at the most. If he keeps it longer than that, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC

22.若比库以不到五补缀的钵索要其它新钵者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。该钵应由那位比库在比库众中捨，而该比库众中最後的钵应给与那位比库:“比库，这是你的钵，应持用至破为止。”这于此是随适的。
If a monk exchanges an almsbowl with fewer than five mends for a new almsbowl, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession. That monk should relinquish that almsbowl to a gathering of monks. He should then be given the last almsbowl belonging to that gathering: ‘Monk, this bowl is yours. Keep it until it breaks.’ This is the proper procedure.SC
23. Yāni kho pana tāni gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭisāyanīyāni bhesajjāni, seyyath'īdaṃ100 — sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, tāni paṭiggahetvā sattāhaparamaṃ sannidhikārakaṃ paribhuñjitabbāni, taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
23.有那些生病比库所服用的药，诸如：熟酥、生酥、油、蜂蜜、糖，接受它们後，最多可储存七日食用。超过此者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
After being received, the tonics allowable for sick monks—that is, ghee, butter, oil, honey, and syrup—should be used from storage for at most seven days. If one uses them longer than that, one commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
24. “Māso seso gimhānan”ti bhikkhunā vassikasāṭika- cīvaraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ, “addhamāso seso gimhānan”ti katvā nivāsetabbaṃ. Orena ce “māso seso gimhānan”ti vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyeseyya, orena'ddhamāso101 seso gimhānan”ti katvā nivāseyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
24.在热季剩下一个月比库可寻求雨浴衣，热季剩下半个月做好後可穿着。假如还未到热季剩下一个月即寻求雨浴衣，还未到热季剩下半个月即做好并穿着者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
When there is a month left of summer, a monk may go looking for cloth for his rainy-season robe. When there is a half-month left, he may sew it and then wear it. If he goes looking for cloth for his rainy-season robe when there is more than a month left of summer, or if he sews it and then wears it when there is more than a half-month left, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
25. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindeyya vā acchindāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
25.若比库自己施衣给比库後，动怒、不满而夺取或令夺取者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If a monk himself gives a robe to a monk, but then, in anger, takes it back or has it taken back, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
26. Yo pana bhikkhu sāmaṃ suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
26.若比库自己乞线後，请织匠们织衣者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If a monk himself asks for thread, and then has weavers weave him robe-cloth, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC

27.非亲戚的家主或女家主请织匠们指定给比库织衣。假如那位比库事先未受到邀请即前往那里的织匠处对衣作指示:“贤友们，这件衣是指定织给我的，请你们做得长、宽、坚固、善织、善编织、善刮平，并做得善平滑，或许我们也会给具寿们送些东西。”若该比库如此说後送了某些东西，乃至是钵食之量，也尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If a male or female householder is having robe-cloth woven by weavers for an unrelated monk and, without first being invited, that monk goes to those weavers and specifies the kind of robe-cloth he wants, saying, ‘This robe-cloth that you are weaving for me, make it long and wide; make it closely woven, well-woven, well-stretched, well-scraped, and well-combed, and perhaps I will even give you a small gift,’ then, in saying that and afterwards giving them a small gift, even a bit of almsfood, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
28. Dasāhānāgataṃ kattikatemāsikapuṇṇamaṃ104 bhikkhuno paneva accekacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya, accekaṃ maññamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ, paṭiggahetvā yāva cīvarakālasamayaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ. Tato ce uttariṃ nikkhipeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
28.在未到咖帝咖第三个月满月的十日内，若比库得到特施衣，知道特施衣的比库应接受，接受後可存放直到衣时。假如存放超过此者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
When there are ten days left to the Kattika full moon that ends the first rainy-season residence and a haste-cloth is given to a monk, he may receive it if he regards it as urgent. He may then store it until the end of the robe season. If he stores it beyond that, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC
29. Upavassaṃ kho pana kattikapuṇṇamaṃ yāni kho pana tāni āraññakāni senāsanāni sāsaṅkasammatāni sappaṭibhayāni, tathārūpesu bhikkhu senāsanesu viharanto ākaṅkhamāno tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipeyya, siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno kocideva paccayo tena cīvarena vippavāsāya, chārattaparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tena cīvarena vippavasitabbaṃ. Tato ce uttariṃ vippavaseyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
29.出雨安居後至咖帝咖满月时，有那些公认有疑惧、有危险的林野坐卧处，住在如此般坐卧处的比库希望时可把三衣中的一件衣放置于俗家间。那位比库若有任何因缘与该衣分离，那位比库最多可离开该衣六夜。假如离开超过此者，除了比库共许外，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
There are wilderness dwellings that are considered risky and dangerous. After observing the Kattika full moon that ends the rainy season, a monk who is staying in such a dwelling may, if he so desires, store one of his three robes in an inhabited area so long as he has a reason for staying apart from that robe. He should stay apart from that robe for six days at the most. If he stays apart from it longer than that, except if the monks have agreed, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC

30. Yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ attano pariṇāmeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
30.若比库明知已施向僧团的所得却令转给自己者，尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
If a monk diverts to himself material support that he knows was intended for the Sangha, he commits an offense entailing relinquishment and confession.SC

The third subchapter on almsbowls is finished.SC
Uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto tiṃsa nissaggiyā pācittiyā dhammā.
诸具寿，已诵出三十尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚法。
Venerables, the thirty rules on relinquishment and confession have been recited.SC
Tatthāyasmante pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
对此我问具寿们是否清净？
In regard to this I ask you, ‘Are you pure in this?’SC
Dutiyampi pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
第二次我再问是否清净？
A second time I ask, ‘Are you pure in this?’SC
Tatiyampi pucchāmi, kaccittha parisuddhā?
第三次我再问是否清净？
A third time I ask, ‘Are you pure in this?’SC
Parisuddhetthāyasmanto, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmi.
具寿们对此是清净的，因此沉默。此事我如是持。
You are pure in this and therefore silent. I will remember it thus.SC
Tiṃsa nissaggiyā pācittiyā dhammā niṭṭhitā.105

Pācittiyā
巴吉帝亚
Rules on Confession
Ime kho panāyasmanto dvenavuti pācittiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
诸具寿，诵出此九十二巴吉帝亚法来。
Venerables, these ninety-two rules on confession come up for recitation.SC
1. Sampajānamusāvāde pācittiyaṃ.
故意虚妄语者，巴吉帝亚。
If a monk lies in full awareness, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
2. Omasavāde pācittiyaṃ.
辱骂语者，巴吉帝亚。
If a monk speaks abusively, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
3. Bhikkhupesuññe pācittiyaṃ.
离间比库者，巴吉帝亚。
If a monk engages in malicious talebearing between monks, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
4. Yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannaṃ padaso dhammaṃ vāceyya, pācittiyaṃ.
若比库给未达上者逐句教诵法者，巴吉帝亚。
If a monk instructs a person who is not fully ordained to memorize the Teaching, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
5. Yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannena uttariṃ diratta-tirattaṃ106 sahaseyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
若比库和未达上者同宿超过两、三夜者，巴吉帝亚。
If a monk lies down more than two or three nights in the same sleeping place as a person who is not fully ordained, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
6. Yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena sahaseyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
若比库和女人同宿者，巴吉帝亚。
If a monk lies down in the same sleeping place as a woman, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
7. Yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmassa uttariṃ chappañcavācāhi107 dhammaṃ deseyya aññatra viññunā purisaviggahena, pācittiyaṃ.
若比库对女人说法超过五、六语，除了有智男子外，巴吉帝亚。
If a monk gives a teaching of more than five or six sentences to a woman, except in the presence of a man who understands, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
8. Yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannassa uttarimanussa- dhammaṃ āroceyya, bhūtasmiṃ pācittiyaṃ.
若比库向未达上者告知上人法，对实得者，巴吉帝亚。
If a monk truthfully tells a person who is not fully ordained of a superhuman quality, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
9. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ anupasampannassa āroceyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, pācittiyaṃ.
若比库把比库的粗重罪告知未达上者，除了比库共许外，巴吉帝亚。
If a monk tells a person who is not fully ordained about a monk’s grave offense, except if the monks have agreed, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
10. Yo pana bhikkhu paṭhaviṃ108 khaṇeyya vā khaṇāpeyya vā pācittiyaṃ.
10.若比库挖掘或令掘地者，巴吉帝亚。
If a monk digs the earth or has it dug, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
Musāvādavaggo paṭhamo.
第一 虚妄语品
The first subchapter on lying is finished.SC
Source pages 130–131 / 原书第 130–131 页

11. Bhūtagāmapātavyatāya109 pācittiyaṃ.
11.损坏生物类者，巴吉帝亚。
If a monk destroys a plant, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
12. Aññavādake, vihesake pācittiyaṃ.
12.异语、恼乱者，巴吉帝亚。
If a monk speaks evasively or harasses, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
13. Ujjhāpanake khīyanake110 pācittiyaṃ.
13.轻毁、嫌责者，巴吉帝亚。
If a monk complains or criticizes, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
14. Yo pana bhikkhu saṅghikaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā bhisiṃ vā kocchaṃ vā ajjhokāse santharitvā vā santharāpetvā vā taṃ pakkamanto neva uddhareyya, na uddharāpeyya, anāpucchā111 vā gaccheyya, pācittiyaṃ.
14.若比库在露地敷设或令敷设僧团的床、椅、褥垫、草席後，离开时既不收起它，也不令收起来，或不嘱咐而离去者，巴吉帝亚。
If a monk takes a bed, a bench, a mattress, or a stool belonging to the Sangha and puts it out in the open or has it put out in the open, and he then departs without putting it away, having it put away, or informing anyone, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
15. Yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre seyyaṃ santharitvā vā santharāpetvā vā taṃ pakkamanto neva uddhareyya, na uddharāpeyya, anāpucchaṃ vā gaccheyya, pācittiyaṃ.
15.若比库在僧团的住处敷设或令敷设卧具後，离开时既不收起它，也不令收起来，或不嘱咐而离去者，巴吉帝亚。
If a monk puts out bedding in a dwelling belonging to the Sangha, or has it put out, and he then departs without putting it away, having it put away, or informing anyone, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
16. Yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre jānaṃ pubbūpagataṃ112 bhikkhuṃ anupakhajja113 seyyaṃ kappeyya “yassa sambādho bhavissati, so pakkamissatī”ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ.
16.若比库在僧团的住处明知有先到的比库，强入而设卧具:“谁要是拥挤，他就会离开。”仅此作为理由，而非其它者，巴吉帝亚。
If, in a dwelling belonging to the Sangha, a monk arranges his sleeping place in a way that encroaches on a monk that he knows arrived there before him, with the intention that anyone who feels crowded will leave, and he does so only for this reason and no other, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
17. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ kupito anattamano saṅghikā vihārā nikkaḍḍheyya vā nikkaḍḍhāpeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
17.若比库动怒、不满而把比库从僧团的住处赶出，或令赶出者，巴吉帝亚。
If a monk, in anger, throws a monk out of a dwelling belonging to the Sangha, or has him thrown out, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
18. Yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre uparivehāsakuṭiyā āhaccapādakaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā abhinisīdeyya vā abhinipajjeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
18.若比库在僧团住所上层空敞的阁楼上，坐或卧脚可拆卸之床或椅者，巴吉帝亚。
If a monk sits down or lies down on a bed or a bench with detachable legs on an upper story in a dwelling belonging to the Sangha, he commits an offense entailing confession.SC
